enabled.description: A flag indicating whether Load Balancer Service is enabled or not.

serviceNetworkDefinition.description: The IPv4 network definition in Gateway CIDR format which will be used by Load Balancer service on edge. All the load balancer service engines associated with the Service Engine Group will be attached to this network. The subnet prefix length must be 25. If nothing is set, the default is 192.168.255.1/25. Default cidr can be configured. Once set, this field cannot be updated. The default IPv4 service network will be used if both the serviceNetworkDefinition and ipv6ServiceNetworkDefinition properties are unset. If both are set, it will still be one service network with a dual IPv4 and IPv6 stack.

ipv6ServiceNetworkDefinition.description:
The IPv6 network definition in Gateway CIDR format which will be used by Load Balancer service on edge. All the load balancer service engines
associated with the Service Engine Group will be attached to this network. Once set, this field cannot be updated.
The default IPv4 service network will be used if both the serviceNetworkDefinition and ipv6ServiceNetworkDefinition properties are unset.
If both are set, it will still be one service network with a dual IPv4 and IPv6 stack.

loadBalancerCloudRef.description: Reference to the Load Balancer Cloud. This cloud is used by Edge Gateway's Load Balancer Virtual Services and Pools.

licenseType.description:
The license type of the backing Load Balancer Cloud.
  • BASIC - Basic edition of the NSX Advanced Load Balancer.
  • ENTERPRISE - Full featured edition of the NSX Advanced Load Balancer.

supportedFeatureSet.description:
The Load Balancer Feature set supported by the Edge Gateway. Allowed values are:
  • STANDARD - Edge Gateway supports STANDARD set of features for Load Balancing.
  • PREMIUM - Edge Gateway supports both STANDARD and PREMIUM set of features for Load Balancing. All Load Balancer Service Engine Groups assigned to this Edge Gateway must support PREMIUM feature set in order to allow PREMIUM features on this gateway.
A Service Engine Group with STANDARD supported feature set can only be assigned to Edge Gateway with STANDARD supported feature set. A Service Engine Group with PREMIUM supported feature set can be assigned to Edge Gateway with both STANDARD and PREMIUM supported feature sets.

transparentModeEnabled.description: A flag indicating whether or not this Edge Gateway has been configured to support transparent load balancing.

EdgeGatewayLoadBalancerConfig.description: Describes Load Balancer Service configuration on an Edge Gateway.

values.description: The list of Load Balancer pool summaries.

EdgeLoadBalancerPoolSummaries.description: List of Load Balancer pool summaries.

values.description: The list of Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor summaries.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorSummaries.description: List of Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor summaries.

enabled.description:
A flag indicating whether DHCP Forwarder is enabled or not. This should be enabled in order
to use the DHCP relay on routed Org vDC networks.

dhcpServers.description:
DHCP server IP addresses. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported.
The DHCP servers can be in any subnet, outside the SDDC, or in the physical network.

EdgeDhcpForwarder.description: Describes the DHCP Forwarder configuration on an Edge Gateway.

ingressProfile.description:
The Gateway QoS profile for ingress traffic. Ingress QoS profile contains configuration of rate limiting properties which can be
applied in ingress direction at Edge Gateway.

egressProfile.description:
The Gateway QoS profile for egress traffic. Egress QoS profile contains configuration of rate limiting properties which can be
applied in egress direction at Edge Gateway.

EdgeQoSConfig.description: Represents the Rate Limiting Configuration for a given Edge Gateway.

id.description: The id of the entity.

name.description: The name of entity.

type.description: Type of the entity

ExtObjectReference.description: Reference for entities which are external to VCD and do not have a VCD URN identifier.

applicationProfile.description: Specifies the application profile for the virtual service such as whether it's HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP/UDP.

EdgeLoadBalancerVirtualService.description: A Virtual Service for an Edge Gateway.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRequestRules.description: An ordered list of HTTP request rules.

name.description: Name of the rule. Must be non-blank and fewer than 1000 characters.

active.description: Whether the rule is active or not.

logging.description: Whether to enable logging with headers on rule match or not.

matchCriteria.description: Different match criteria defined for the rule.

headerActions.description: HTTP header rewrite action. It can be configured in combination with rewrite URL action.

redirectAction.description: HTTP redirect action. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

rewriteUrlAction.description: HTTP request URL rewrite action. It can be configured in combination with multiple header actions.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRequestRule.description:
Defines a HTTP request rule. It consists of a match criteria along with the actions to execute once the criteria is satisfied.
If the match criteria is not set, defined actions will be be executed for all requests.
Multiple header actions are supported which can be configured in combination with rewrite URL action. Redirect action can only be configured alone.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRequestMatchCriter.description: Defines a HTTP request match criteria. If multiple matches are configured, it is treated as logically AND operation. All match types must be true for the request match criteria to be satisfied.

action.description: One of the following HTTP header actions. Options - ADD, REMOVE, REPLACE.

name.description: HTTP header name. Must be non-blank and fewer than 10240 characters.

value.description: HTTP header value. Must be non-blank and fewer than 10240 characters.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpHeaderAction.description: Defines the action to add, modify or replace an HTTP header.

statusCode.description: One of the redirect status codes - 301, 302, 307.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRedirectAction.description: Defines the action to redirect the HTTP request.

host.description: Host to use for the rewritten URL. If omitted, the existing host will be used.

path.description: Path to use for the rewritten URL. If omitted, the existing path will be used.

query.description: Query string to use or append to the existing query string in the rewritten URL.

keepQuery.description: Whether or not to keep the existing query string when rewriting the URL.  Defaults to true.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRewriteUrlAction.description: Defines the action to rewrite the HTTP request URL.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpResponseRules.description: An ordered list of HTTP response rules.

name.description: Name of the rule. Must be non-blank and fewer than 1000 characters.

active.description: Whether the rule is active or not.

logging.description: Whether to enable logging with headers on rule match or not.

matchCriteria.description: Different match criteria defined for the rule.

headerActions.description: HTTP header rewrite action. It can be configured in combination with rewrite location header action.

rewriteLocationHeaderAction.description: HTTP location header rewrite action. It can be configured in combination with header rewrite actions.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpResponseRule.description:
Defines a HTTP response rule. It consists of a match criteria along with the actions to execute once the criteria is satisfied.
If the match criteria is not set, defined actions will be be executed for all requests.

clientIpMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on client IP addresses.

servicePortMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on virtual service ports.

methodMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on HTTP methods such as GET, PUT, DELETE, POST etc.

protocol.description: Defines match criteria based on HTTP or HTTPS protocol.

pathMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on URI paths.

queryMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on query strings which are in key=value format.

cookieMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on cookies.

locationHeaderMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on response location header.

requestHeaderMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on the request headers.

responseHeaderMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on the response headers.

statusCodeMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on response status codes.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpResponseMatchCrite.description: Defines a response match criteria. If multiple matches are configured, it is treated as logically AND operation. All match types must be true for the response match criteria to be satisfied.

matchCriteria.description: Criterion to use for IP address matching the HTTP request. Options - IS_IN, IS_NOT_IN.

addresses.description: Either a single IP address, a range of IP addresses or a network CIDR.  Must contain at least one item.

EdgeVirtualServiceIpAddressMatch.description: Defines an IP address match criterion.

matchCriteria.description: Criterion to use for port matching the HTTP request. Options - IS_IN, IS_NOT_IN.

ports.description: Listening TCP ports. Allowed values are 1-65535.

matchCriteria.description: Criterion to use for matching the method in the HTTP request. Options - IS_IN, IS_NOT_IN.

methods.description: HTTP methods to match. Options - GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, TRACE, CONNECT, PATCH, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, MKCOL, COPY, MOVE, LOCK, UNLOCK.

EdgeVirtualServiceMethodMatch.description: Defines an HTTP method match criterion.

matchCriteria.description:
Criterion to use for matching the path in the HTTP request URI.
Options - BEGINS_WITH, DOES_NOT_BEGIN_WITH, CONTAINS, DOES_NOT_CONTAIN, ENDS_WITH, DOES_NOT_END_WITH, EQUALS, DOES_NOT_EQUAL, REGEX_MATCH, REGEX_DOES_NOT_MATCH.

matchStrings.description: String values to match the path.

EdgeVirtualServicePathMatch.description: Defines an HTTP request URI path match criterion.

matchCriteria.description:
Criterion to use for matching cookies in the HTTP request.
Options - EXISTS, DOES_NOT_EXIST, BEGINS_WITH, DOES_NOT_BEGIN_WITH, CONTAINS, DOES_NOT_CONTAIN, ENDS_WITH, DOES_NOT_END_WITH, EQUALS, DOES_NOT_EQUAL.

key.description: Name of the HTTP cookie whose value is to be matched. Must be non-blank and fewer than 10240 characters.

value.description: String values to match for an HTTP cookie. Must be fewer than 10240 characters.

EdgeVirtualServiceCookieMatch.description: Defines an HTTP cookie match criterion.

matchCriteria.description:
Criterion to use for matching headers and cookies in the HTTP request amd response.
Options - EXISTS, DOES_NOT_EXIST, BEGINS_WITH, DOES_NOT_BEGIN_WITH, CONTAINS, DOES_NOT_CONTAIN, ENDS_WITH, DOES_NOT_END_WITH, EQUALS, DOES_NOT_EQUAL.

value.description: String values to match for an HTTP header.

EdgeVirtualServiceSpecificHeaderMatch.description: Defines an HTTP match criterion for a specific header.

key.description: Name of the HTTP header whose value is to be matched. Must be non-blank and fewer than 10240 characters.

EdgeVirtualServiceHeaderMatch.description: Defines an HTTP header match criterion.

matchCriteria.description: Criterion to use for matching the HTTP response status code. Options - IS_IN, IS_NOT_IN.

statusCodes.description: A list of single status code or range of status codes.

EdgeVirtualServiceStatusCodeMatch.description:
Defines an HTTP response status code match criterion. HTTP response codes are grouped into following five categories:
  • Informational responses (100 – 199).
  • Successful responses (200 – 299).
  • Redirection messages (300 – 399).
  • Client error responses (400 – 499).
  • Server error responses (500 – 599).

protocol.description: HTTP or HTTPS protocol. Must be non-blank.

host.description: Host to which redirect the request. Default is the original host.

port.description: Port to which redirect the request. Default is 80 for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS protocol.

path.description: Path to which redirect the request. Default is the original path.

keepQuery.description: Keep or drop the query of the incoming request URI in the redirected URI.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRewriteLocationHea.description: Defines the action to rewrite location header in the HTTP response.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpSecurityRules.description: An ordered list of HTTP security rules.

name.description: Name of the rule. Must be non-blank and fewer than 1000 characters.

active.description: Whether the rule is active or not.

logging.description: Whether to enable logging on rule match or not.

matchCriteria.description: Different match criteria defined for the rule.

allowOrCloseConnectionAction.description:
Action to allow the incoming request or close the connection. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions. Allowed values are:
  • ALLOW - Allow the incoming request.
  • CLOSE - Close the incoming connection.

rateLimitAction.description: Action to apply rate limit on incoming requests. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

redirectToHttpsAction.description: Action to redirect the incoming request to HTTPS. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

localResponseAction.description: Action to send a local HTTP response. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpSecurityRule.description:
Defines a HTTP security rule. It consists of a match criteria along with the actions to execute once the criteria is satisfied.
If the match criteria is not set, defined actions will be be executed for all requests.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpSecurityMatchCrite.description: Defines a HTTP security match criteria. If multiple matches are configured, it is treated as logically AND operation. All match types must be true for the security match criteria to be satisfied.

count.description: Maximum number of connections, requests or packets permitted each period. Allowed values are 1-1000000000.

period.description: Time value in seconds to enforce rate count. Allowed values are 1-1000000000. Unit is Second.

closeConnectionAction.description: Action to close the incoming connection. Only allowed value is CLOSE. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

redirectAction.description: Action to redirect the HTTP request. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

localResponseAction.description: Action to send a local HTTP response. It cannot be configured in combination with other actions.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpRateLimitAction.description:
Defines the action to apply rate limit on incoming requests. It consists of rate limiting properties and one of the actions to execute upon reaching rate limit.
If not actions are provided, rate limiting will only be reported.

statusCode.description: Status code of the response. Options - 200, 204, 403, 404, 429, 501.

content.description: Content to be used in the local HTTP response body.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpLocalResponseActio.description: Defines the action to send a local HTTP response.

port.description: The port which to redirect the request.

EdgeVirtualServiceRedirectToHttpsAction.description: Defines the action to redirect the incoming request to HTTPS.

EdgeVirtualServiceHttpLogSummaries.description: A list of Virtual Service log summaries.

criticalityCodes.description: List of codes which indicate why a log is critical.

criticalitySummary.description: If the connection or request is determined to be critical, then this field provides a human-readable summary of all critical issues.

clientLocation.description: The client's country of origin for the IP address or Internal for private IP addresses.

clientRtt.description: The TCP round trip time between the load balancer and client.

rewrittenUriPath.description: The URI path of the request rewritten by the load balancer.

uriQuery.description: The URI query string of the request from the client.

rewrittenUriQuery.description: The URI query string of the request rewritten by the load balancer.

redirectedUri.description: The redirect URI provided to the client from the load balancer.

applicationRedirectUri.description: The redirect URI generated by the application.

httpVersion.description: HTTP version used during the request.

userAgent.description: The raw client HTTP User-Agent header.

clientBrowser.description: The web browser of the connecting device.

clientOs.description: The operating system of the connecting device.

xffHeader.description: The X-Forwarded-For request header identifies the originating client IP address.

applicationRtt.description: The TCP round trip time between the load balancer and the application.

applicationResponseLength.description: The size of the HTTP header plus content returned from the application to the load balancer.

applicationResponseCode.description: The HTTP response code sent by the application.

applicationResponseTime.description: The duration in milliseconds the application takes to process the request.

dataTransferTime.description: Time required in milliseconds for the application to transmit the requested data.

originalRequestHeaders.description: The unmodified headers as sent in the request from the client.

modifiedRequestHeaders.description: The client request headers as altered by the load balancer.

originalResponseHeaders.description: The unmodified headers as sent in the response from the application.

modifiedResponseHeaders.description: The application response headers as altered by the load balancer.

sourceIpAddress.description: IPv4 address of the source of the client connection to the Virtual Service. The source IP may differ from client IP unless client IP preservation is configured.

ipV6SourceIpAddress.description: IPv6 address of the source of the client connection to the Virtual Service. The source IP may differ from client IP unless client IP preservation is configured.

httpSecurityPolicyRuleName.description: The security HTTP policy rule that was used.

httpRequestPolicyRuleName.description: The request HTTP policy rule that was used.

httpResponsePolicyRuleName.description: The response HTTP policy rule that was used.

wafActivity.description: Log details of WAF activity. Its presence indicates that at least one of the WAF rule was hit.

requestHeaderLatency.description: The number of milliseconds the WAF spent processing the request headers.

requestBodyLatency.description: The number of milliseconds the WAF spent processing the request body.

responseHeaderLatency.description: The number of milliseconds the WAF spent processing the response headers.

responseBodyLatency.description: The number of milliseconds the WAF spent processing the response body.

matchedSignatures.description: A list of WAF signatures that the request has matched.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafActivity.description: A virtual service WAF activity log.

groupName.description: Name of the group containing the WAF signature.

phase.description: WAF processing phase during which match occurred.

matchDetails.description: List of details related to this signature match.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafSignatureMatchSumma.description: A high-level summary of the WAF signature matching the logged request.

element.description: Element that triggered the WAF signature match.

value.description: Value that triggered the WAF signature match.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafRecommendations.description: A list of WAF recommendations for false positive remediation.

summary.description: Summary of the WAF recommendation. For example, 'Add PATCH to the list of allowed methods in the WAF Profile'.

reasoning.description: Reasoning of the WAF recommendation. For example, 'Request method PATCH seems to be expected'.

riskAssessment.description: Risk assessment of the WAF recommendation. For example, 'This will not affect the functionality of the application'.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafRecommendation.description: A WAF recommendation for false positive remediation.

EdgeVirtualServiceL4LogSummaries.description: A list of Virtual Service L4 log summaries.

active.description: Whether the WAF is active or not. Defaults to false. WAF requires Edge Gateway Load Balancer with PREMIUM feature set.

mode.description:
Mode of the WAF. Supported values are:
  • DETECTION - A log entry is created when the request is flagged based on the specified rules.
  • ENFORCEMENT - It will be blocked when the request is flagged based on the specified rules.
Defaults to DETECTION.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafConfig.description: WAF configuration of a virtual service.

values.description: An ordered list of WAF allowlist items.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafAllowlist.description:
A set of conditions under which the request may bypass or be less strictly enforced by the WAF.
Once match criteria for an individual allowlist item is met, all subsequent allowlist items are not evaluated.

name.description: Name of the WAF allowlist item.

active.description: Whether the WAF allowlist item is active or not.

matchCriteria.description: Defines a WAF allowlist item match criteria.

action.description:
Actions to be performed on the request upon successful matching. Supported actions are:
  • BYPASS - Bypasses WAF signature evaluation for this request.
  • CONTINUE - Proceeds with WAF signature evaluation.
  • DETECT - Proceeds with WAF signature evaluation, but changes the WAF mode to DETECTION for this request.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafAllowlistItem.description: WAF allowlist item of a virtual service.

hostHeaderMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on request host header.

clientIpMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on client IP addresses.

pathMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on URI paths.

methodMatch.description: Defines match criteria based on HTTP methods such as GET, PUT, DELETE, POST etc.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafAllowlistItemMatchC.description: Defines a WAF allowlist item Match criteria. At least one match must be configured. If multiple matches are configured, it is treated as logically AND operation. All match types must be true for the request match criteria to be satisfied.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafSignatureGroups.description: WAF signature groups of a virtual service.

id.description: The identifier of the WAF group.

name.description: The name of the WAF group.

active.description: Whether the WAF group is active or not.

totalSignaturesCount.description: The total number of WAF signatures in the group.

activeSignaturesCount.description: The number of active WAF signatures in the group.

overriddenSignaturesCount.description:
The number of overridden WAF signatures in the group.
A signature is considered overridden when its default mode is changed by the user. For example, if the VS WAF mode is ENFORCEMENT
a signature is overridden if the user has changed the mode to DETECTION.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafSignatureGroup.description: WAF signature group of a virtual service.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafSignatures.description: WAF signatures in a specified group of a virtual service.

id.description: The identifier of the WAF signature.

name.description: Name of the WAF signature.

active.description: Whether the WAF signature is active or not.

mode.description:
Mode of the WAF signature. Supported values are:
  • DETECTION - A log entry is created when the request is flagged based on the specified rules.
  • ENFORCEMENT - Request will be blocked when it is flagged based on the specified rules.
  • DEFAULT - Use mode specified in top-level WAF configuration.

overridden.description: Whether or not the mode or active state of the WAF signature has been changed from its default value.

currentVersion.description: Current version of the WAF Core Rule Set.

availableUpgrade.description: Latest available version of WAF Core Rule Set. If this is unset, then there is no new upgrade available.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafCrsInfo.description: Defines WAF Core Rule Set available upgrade config.

version.description: Latest available version of the WAF Core Rule Set.

addedRulesCount.description: Number of new rules added in Core Rule Set of latest available version as compared to current version.

removedRulesCount.description: Number of rules removed in Core Rule Set of latest available version as compared to current version.

changedRulesCount.description: Number of rules changed in Core Rule Set of latest available version as compared to current version.

EdgeVirtualServiceWafCrsAvailableUpgrade.description: Defines the latest available version of WAF Core Rule Set including the number of rules added, removed or modified.

name.description: Name for the Load Balancer Pool. Name is unique across all pools for an Edge Gateway.

defaultPort.description: The destination server port used by the traffic sent to the member.

portTranslationEnabled.description:
Whether to enable port translation or not. By default, requests are forwarded to servers on the default port of virtual service.
When set to false, requests are forwarded to servers on the same port as the receiving port of the virtual service.

gracefulTimeoutPeriod.description: Maximum time (in minutes) to gracefully disable a member. Virtual service waits for the specified time before terminating the existing connections to the members that are disabled. Special values: 0 represents 'Immediate', -1 represents 'Infinite'.

algorithm.description:
The algorithm for choosing a member within the pool's list of available members for each new connection. Default value is "LEAST_CONNECTIONS". Supported algorithms are:
  • LEAST_CONNECTIONS
  • ROUND_ROBIN
  • CONSISTENT_HASH
  • FASTEST_RESPONSE
  • LEAST_LOAD
  • FEWEST_SERVERS
  • RANDOM
  • FEWEST_TASKS
  • CORE_AFFINITY
CONSISTENT_HASH uses Source IP Address hash. Using FASTEST_RESPONSE, LEAST_LOAD, FEWEST_SERVERS, RANDOM, FEWEST_TASKS, CORE_AFFINITY algorithms requires an Edge Gateway Load Balancer with PREMIUM feature set.

healthMonitors.description:
Member server's health can be monitored by using one or more health monitors. Active monitors
generate synthetic traffic and mark a server up or down based on the response.
This is deprecated in favor of the top-level health monitor API. Setting this property will throw an error.

persistenceProfile.description: Selected persistence profile for the Load Balancer Pool.

members.description:
The list of destination servers which are used by the Load Balancer Pool to direct
load balanced traffic. Only one of members or memberGroupRef can be specified.

memberGroupRef.description:
Reference to the Edge Firewall Group representing destination servers which are used by the
Load Balancer Pool to direct load balanced traffic. Only one of members or memberGroupRef
can be specified.

virtualServiceRefs.description: The list of Load Balancer Virtual Services associated with this Load balancer Pool.

gatewayRef.description: The Edge Gateway associated with this Load Balancer Pool.

caCertificateRefs.description: The root certificates to use when validating certificates presented by the pool members.

commonNameCheckEnabled.description:
Whether to check the common name of the certificate presented by the pool member. This cannot be enabled
if no caCertificateRefs are specified.

domainNames.description:
A list of domain names which will be used to verify the common names or subject alternative names presented by the pool
member certificates. It is performed only when common name check (commonNameCheckEnabled) is enabled. If common name check
is enabled, but domain names are not specified then the incoming host header will be used to check the certificate.

sslEnabled.description: Whether SSL is enabled for this Pool.

EdgeLoadBalancerPool.description: Specifies the Load Balancer pool configuration.

healthMonitors.x-vcloud-deprecated-alternative: Use top-level query for health monitors with pool filter.

EdgeLoadBalancerAnalyticReports.description:
A set of Load Balancer analytic reports.  Each report in the list represents
a timeseries of Edge Gateway Load Balancer runtime data.

componentId.description: The virtual service or pool URN identifier.

metric.description: The metric for this specific report.  Supported metrics can be determined by using the supported metrics API.

units.description:
The units for this specific report. Units may be one of the following
  • PER_SECOND
  • METRIC_COUNT
  • BITS_PER_SECOND
  • BYTES_PER_SECOND
  • MILLISECONDS
  • PERCENT
Units are derived from the reported metric.

data.description: The metric timeseries of data for this report.

EdgeLoadBalancerAnalyticReport.description:
A Load Balancer Analytic Report. It represents a timeseries
of Edge Gateway Load Balancer runtime data.

startTime.description: Start time of data series.  ISO 8601 format (i.e. 2020-07-24T00:00:00).

endTime.description: End time of data series.  ISO 8601 format (i.e. 2020-07-24T00:00:00).

EdgeLoadBalancerMetricSummaryStats.description: A statistical summary of the data in the report.

value.description: Data value for the sampled time.  ISO 8601 format (i.e. 2020-07-24T00:00:00).

EdgeLoadBalancerMetricData.description: A data point in the metric timeseries.

EdgeLoadBalancerAnalyticMetrics.description: The list of supported metrics.  These metrics can be used for building report queries.

key.description: The metric key to be used in report queries.

id.description: The unique ID of this Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor. On updates, the ID is required. For create, a new ID will be generated.

name.description: Name of the Health monitor. Name of the system defined monitors are prefixed with System for example 'System-HTTP'.

description.description: Description of the Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

type.description:
Type of the health monitors. A value of "-" represents an unknown type. Supported values are:
  • HTTP - HTTP request/response is used to validate health.
  • HTTPS - Used against HTTPS encrypted web servers to validate health.
  • TCP - TCP connection is used to validate health.
  • UDP - A UDP datagram is used to validate health.
  • PING - An ICMP ping is used to validate health.
Extra type-specific options can be set in the respective "settings" property.

systemDefined.description: Whether the Health Monitor is system defined.

successfulChecksCount.description: Number of successful checks required to mark an unhealthy Load Balancer Pool member as healthy.

failedChecksCount.description: Number of failed checks required to mark a healthy Load Balancer Pool member as unhealthy.

sendInterval.description: Frequency (in seconds) at which to send health checks to Load Balancer Pool.

receiveTimeout.description: Maximum elapsed duration (in seconds) after which a health check is considered to have failed.

httpSettings.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to an HTTPS Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

httpsSettings.description: Settings applicable to HTTPS Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.

tcpSettings.description: Settings applicable to TCP Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.

udpSettings.description: Settings applicable to UDP Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.

gatewayRef.description: The Edge Gateway associated with this Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor. This field is empty for system- and provider-scoped monitors.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitor.description:
Specifies the health monitoring configuration for a Load Balancer Pool.
Health monitors are used to monitor health of the Load Balancer Pool's member servers.

port.description: The port to use for the health check.  If not specified, the Load Balancer Pool port will be used by default.

requestHeader.description: The request header string to send to the application as part of the health check.

requestBody.description: The request body string to send to the application as part of the health check.

useExactRequest.description: Use the exact HTTP request as specified by the user without automatic insertion of any headers (like Host).

expectedResponseData.description: Keyword to match in the first 2KB of the response headers or the response body. If no match made, the Load Balancer Pool member will be marked as unhealthy.

expectedResponseCodes.description:
Response status code patterns to match during health check. If no match made, the Load Balancer Pool member will be marked as unhealthy. One or more of the following values can be specified:
  • 1XX - matches response status codes 100-199.
  • 2XX - matches response status codes 200-299.
  • 3XX - matches response status codes 300-399.
  • 4XX - matches response status codes 400-499.
  • 5XX - matches response status codes 500-599.
  • ANY - matches any response status code.
If nothing specified, the pattern defaults to 2XX.

authSettings.description: Settings used to authenticate to perform the health check.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorHttpSetting.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to both HTTP and HTTPS Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.

type.description: Type of authentication to use to perform the health check.  Can be either NTLM, BASIC or NONE.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorAuthenticat.description: Specifies authentication settings for either HTTP or HTTPS Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorHttpsSettin.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to a HTTPS Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorTcpSettings.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to a TCP Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorUdpSettings.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to a UDP Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorAssignments.description: List of Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor assignments.

id.description: The unique ID of this Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor assignment. For create, a new ID will be generated.

healthMonitorRef.description: The Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor that is assigned.

loadBalancerPoolRef.description: The Load Balancer Pool to which the Health Monitor is assigned.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorAssignment.description: Specifies a Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor assignment.

id.description: The id of the Edge Cluster in URN format.

For specific profile types where there are no corresponding profiles defined in the template, VCD will use the default NSX-T profile.

enabled.description: Whether the DHCP service is currently enabled on network.

leaseTime.description:
The amount of time in seconds of how long a DHCP IP will be leased out for. The minimum is 60s while the maximum is 4,294,967,295s, which is
roughly 49,710 days.

dhcpPools.description: Range of DHCP IP addresses. These should not be set for RELAY mode.

mode.description:
This value describes how the DHCP service is configured for this network. Once a DHCP service has been created, the mode attribute cannot be changed. The mode field will default to 'EDGE' if it is not provided. This field only applies to networks backed by an NSX-T network provider.
  • The supported values are EDGE ,NETWORK and RELAY.
  • If EDGE is specified, the DHCP service of the edge is used to obtain DHCP IPs.
  • If NETWORK is specified, a DHCP server is created for use by this network.
  • If RELAY is specified, all the DHCP client requests will be relayed to Gateway DHCP Forwarder service. This mode is only supported for Routed Org vDC Networks.
In order to use DHCP for IPV6, NETWORK mode must be used. Routed networks which are using NETWORK DHCP services can be disconnected from the edge gateway and still retain their DHCP configuration, however DHCP configuration will be removed during connection change for networks using EDGE or RELAY DHCP mode.

ipAddress.description:
The IP address of the DHCP service. This is required upon create if using NETWORK mode. This field only applies to networks backed by an NSX-T
network provider.

dnsServers.description: The DNS server IPs to be assigned by this DHCP service. The IP type must match the IP type of the subnet on which the DHCP config is being created.

VdcNetworkDhcpConfig.description:
Configuration for the DHCP service that runs for the network. In order to use DHCPv6 in NSX-T, the network must be configured in EDGE mode, the network must be
attached to a router, and the router must have a SLAAC profile configured with DHCPv6 mode.

enabled.description: Whether the DHCP address pool is currently enabled

from the static IP pool of the network.
For IPv6, when not specified, Stateless Address Autoconfiguration (SLAAC)
is used to auto-assign an IPv6 address to the DHCPv6 clients.
Automatic allocation of available static IP address is only allowed for IPv4 bindings.
This address must not overlap with the DHCP pool.

leaseTime.description:
The amount of time in seconds of how long a DHCP IP will be leased out for. The minimum is 60s while the maximum is 4,294,967,295s, which is
roughly 49,710 days. Default is 24 hours.

Reference to the Segment Profile Template that is used when creating/updating this network. This reference will be returned if the original template

Where the referenced template is sourced from.

  • GLOBAL - The template comes from the global default for the VCD site.

values.description: The list of Manual IP Reservations.

id.description: The identifier of the Manual IP Reservation in URN format.

name.description: Display name for the Manual IP Reservation.

description.description: Description for the Manual IP Reservation.

networkRef.description: The network this Manual IP Reservation belongs to. This is required for creation and cannot be updated.

ipAddresses.description:
The list of specific IP addresses to reserve. This value can be a single IP such as "192.168.1.1", an IP Range such as "192.168.1.1-192.168.1.2",
or a list of IPs such as "192.168.1.1,192.168.1.2,192.168.1.3". This property can be updatable: new IPs will be reserved and any IP no longer
in the original list will be released. For the case where user needs to request a number of free/non-specific IP Addresses,
user can use the property "ipQuantity"; the newly reserved IP Addresses will be appended to this list.
The maximum supported number of IPs is 5: sum of this property's list size and the property "ipQuantity".

ipQuantity.description:
The number of free IP addresses to reserve. Specifying the quantity will reserve the given number of free IP addresses
within the optionally-specified "subnet", and the list of newly reserved IP Addresses will be added to the property "ipAddresses".
The maximum supported number of IPs is 5: sum of this property and the list size of property "ipAddresses".
This property is only applicable on creating or updating of Manual IP Reservation.

subnet.description:
When ipQuantity is set, for dual-stack networks, user can optionally choose the specific subnet CIDR in the network that specifies
where to reserve the free IPs from. On dual-stack networks, if this property is not set, then the default subnet is the IPv4 subnet.
For single-stack networks, this property is ignored.
This property is only applicable on creating or updating of Manual IP Reservation.

expirationType.description:
The type that determines when this IP reservation and its reserved IPs expires and will be automatically removed/released.
  • VAPP_BASED - Expiration is based on the lifecycle of a vApp. When vApp is removed from VCD, this Manual IP Reservation will also be automatically removed. The property "vAppRef" must be set.
  • TIME_BASED - Expiration is based on the number of days. The property "expirationDate" must be set.

expirationDate.description:
The ISO-8601 date that this Manual IP Reservation is valid for until it expires and will be eventually cancelled/removed
automatically. Unsetting this value means that there is no expiration.
This property must be set if expiration type is TIME_BASED; otherwise, it is ignored.
This property is only applicable on creating or updating of Manual IP Reservation.

expirationVAppRef.description:
The vApp associated with this Manual IP Reservation as it pertains to the expiration type.
When vApp is removed from VCD, this Manual IP Reservation is also removed.
This property must be set if expiration type is "VAPP_BASED"; otherwise, it is ignored.

expirationVAppVdcRef.description:
The vDC that the vApp associated with this Manual IP Reservation is on.
This property is read-only and only set for "VAPP_BASED" type.

allowIpUsageByServiceOrVm.description:
By default (this property set to false), IPs in the reservation are not allowed to be used as manual static IP on a
VM or Edge's Load Balancer VIP. Setting this to true will override this behavior and allow the IPs to be used.

removeIpAfterUsage.description:
True means that when the IP is used as Edge's Load Balancer VIP or VM's static IP, the IP will be removed from the reservation.
If there are no more IPs in the reservation, the reservation itself will also be deleted.
True value allows the user to temporarily hold the IP so that it is not inadvertently used or reserved again before it is actually used.
This property is ignored if "allowIpUsageByServiceOrVm" is set to false.

createdBy.description: The name of the user that created the reservation. This property is read-only.

updatedBy.description: The name of the user that last updated the reservation. This property is read-only.

orgRef.description: The organization this Manual IP Reservation belongs to. This property is read-only.

creationDate.description: ISO-8601 date when the Manual IP Reservation is created. This property is read-only.

isNdSnoopingEnabled.description:
Whether ND snooping is enabled.  If true, this method will snoop the NS (Neighbor Solicitation) and NA
(Neighbor Advertisement) messages in the ND (Neighbor Discovery Protocol) family of messages which are transmitted by a VM.
From the NS messages, we will learn about the source which sent this NS message. From the NA message, we will learn the resolved
address in the message which the VM is a recipient of. Addresses snooped by this method are subject to TOFU.

ndSnoopingLimit.description: Maximum number of ND (Neighbor Discovery Protocol) snooped IPv6 addresses.

isDuplicateIpDetectionEnabled.description:
Whether duplicate IP detection is enabled. Duplicate IP detection is used to determine if there is any IP conflict
with any other port on the same logical switch. If a conflict is detected, then the IP is marked as a duplicate on
the port where the IP was discovered last.

ELASTIC_N_PLUS_M_BUFFER - Service Engines will scale out to N active nodes with M nodes as buffer.
ELASTIC_ACTIVE_ACTIVE - Active-Active with scale out.
LEGACY_ACTIVE_STANDBY - Traditional single Active-Standby configuration

alreadyImported.description: True if the service engine group is already imported. The service engine group cannot be imported again.

NsxAlbServiceEngineGroup.description: An NSX-ALB Cloud's Service Engine Group

ipSpaceRanges.description: List of IP Ranges. These are logically treated as a single block of IPs for allocation purpose.

ipSpaceInternalScope.description:
This defines the exact span of IP addresses in a CIDR format within which all IP Ranges and IP Prefixes of this IP Space must be contained.
This typically defines the span of IP addresses used within this Data Center.
This is used by the system for creation of NAT rules and BGP prefixes.

ipSpaceExternalScope.description:
This defines the total span of IP addresses to which the IP space has access. This is used by the system for creation of NAT rules and BGP prefixes.
This typically defines the span of IP addresses outside the bounds of
this Data Center.
For the internet, this may be 0.0.0.0/0.  For a WAN, this could be 10.0.0.0/8.

routeAdvertisementEnabled.description:
Whether the route advertisement is enabled for this IP Space or not. If true, the routed Org VDC networks which are configured from this IP Space will be
advertised from the connected Edge Gateway to the Provider Gateway. Route advertisement must be enabled on a particular network for it to be advertised.
Networks from the PRIVATE IP Spaces will only be advertised if the associated Provider Gateway is owned by the Organization.

defaultGatewayServiceConfig.description:
Default gateway services configurations such as NAT and Firewall rules that a user can apply on either the Provider Gateway or Edge Gateway
depending on the network topology. Note that re-applying the default services on the Provider Gateway or Edge Gateway
may delete/update/create services that are managed/created by VCD.

canManageQuota.description:
Whether quotas for floating IP Ranges and IP Prefixes can be managed for this IP Space.
This is set to true for public and shared services Ip Spaces.
For private Ip Spaces, it is set to true if the Ip Space is owned by an organization that manages other organizations.

IpSpaceFloatingIpSuggestions.description: List of IP Space floating IP Address Suggestions.

IpSpaceIpPrefixSuggestions.description: List of IP Space IP Prefix Suggestions.

sequences.description:
Ordered list of IP prefix sequences which can be generated.
Number of sequences will be limited to the first 10 sequences if specified prefixCount is greater than 10.

lastSequence.description: Last sequence which can be generated based on input values for IP Prefix.

IpPrefixSequenceList.description: An object specifying the IP prefix sequences that can be generated from an IP Prefix.

cross-reference.description: Starting IP address for the IP prefix.
The prefix length.
Number of prefixes to generate.

type.description:
The type of the IP allocation requested. Possible values are:
  • FLOATING_IP - For allocation of floating IP addresses from defined IP Space ranges.
  • IP_PREFIX - For allocation of IP prefix sequences from defined IP Space prefixes.

quantity.description:
The number of IP addresses or IP Prefix blocks to allocate. Specifying quantity will allocate the given number of any free IP addresses
or IP Prefixes within the IP Space. To use a specific IP address or IP Prefix, please use the value field to request a specific value.

prefixLength.description: The prefix length of an IP Prefix to allocate. This is required if type is IP_PREFIX. This field is only required if the request is for a specific quantity of IP Prefixes and not needed if request value is specified.

value.description:
The specific IP addresses or IP Prefix to allocate. If this property is set, the quantity value should not be set.
For IP_PREFIX type, only a single IP PREFIX CIDR is supported.
For FLOATING_IP type, this value can be single IP such as "192.168.1.1", an IP Range such as "192.168.1.1-192.168.1.2",
or a CIDR block such as "192.168.1.32/28". For IP Range and CIDR block, the maximum supported number of IPs is 16 (i.e. prefix length 
of 28 for CIDR block for IPv4).

purpose.description: This field allows users to specify the intended use or reason for requesting this IP allocation.

IpSpaceIpAllocationRequest.description:
An IP Space IP Allocation request object. An IP Space IP allocation request can either request a specific IP address/IP prefix or request
a specific number of any free IP Addresses/IP Prefixes within an IP Space.
To allocate a specific IP Address or IP Prefix, the value field should be used and the IP Address or Prefix should be specified.
To allocate up to 5 of any free IP Addresses or Prefixes within the IP Space, use the quantity field to specify the amount.
The value and quantity fields should not be set simultaneously.

IpSpaceIpAllocations.description: List of IP Space IP allocations.

id.description: The identifier of the IP Space IP allocation in URN format.

type.description:
The type of the IP allocation. Possible values are:
  • FLOATING_IP - For allocation of floating IP addresses from defined IP Space ranges.
  • IP_PREFIX - For allocation of IP prefix sequences from defined IP Space prefixes.

value.description: An individual IP Address or an IP Prefix which is allocated.

allocationDate.description: Date when the IP address or IP prefix is allocated. This property is read-only.

orgRef.description: Reference to the organization where the IP is allocated.

usageState.description:
Specifies current usage state of an allocated IP. Possible values are:
  • UNUSED - the allocated IP is current not being used in the system.
  • USED - the allocated IP is currently in use in the system. An allocated IP address or IP Prefix is considered used if it is being used in network services such as NAT rule or in Org VDC network definition.
  • USED_MANUAL - the allocated IP is marked for manual usage. Allocation description can be referenced to get information about the manual usage.

description.description: Description about usage of an IP if the usageState is USED_MANUAL.

reservedForUser.description:
If the usage state transitions to or is in USED_MANUAL state, this property can be set to have the IP or IP Prefix
be reserved for the user that is performing the update. Reserving the IP or IP prefix means that only that same user
can use the IP for Edge services or use the IP Prefix during Org VDC network creation. If this property is unset
or set to false, any user with access to the IP or IP Prefix can use it.
When the usage state transitions from USED_MANUAL to UNUSED, this property will be false.
By default, this property is set to false.

reservedForUserName.description:
The user name that this IP Allocation is reserved for. This is set only if the property reservedForUser is
set to true in USED_MANUAL state. This field is read-only.

usedByRef.description:
Reference to the entity using the IP, such as an Edge Gateway Reference if the Floating IP is used for NAT or Org VDC network reference
if IP Prefix is used for network definition. This property is read-only.

usageCategories.description:
The list of service categories where the IP address is being used. Typically this can be one of: SNAT, DNAT, REFLEXIVE_NAT,
LOAD_BALANCER, IPSEC_VPN, SSL_VPN or L2_VPN. This property is read-only.

customQuotas.description:
Custom IP Space quotas applied to the Organization. A custom quota for floating IPs or
IP Prefix overrides the default quotas applied to the associated Organization.
Setting the customQuotas property to NULL will result in resetting all the overridden quotas to their respective defaults.
Setting the specific overridden quota value within customQuotas will result in resetting the overridden quota value to its default value.
A Quota of -1 means there is no cap to the number of IP addresses or IP Prefixes that can be allocated.
A Quota of 0 means that the IP addresses or IP Prefixes cannot be allocated.

totalIpCount.description: The number of IP addresses defined by the static ip pools. If the network contains any IpV6 subnets, the total ip count will be null.

The Organization that this external network belongs to. This is unset for the external networks which are available to more than one organization.
If this external network is dedicated to an Edge Gateway, this field is read-only and will be set to the Organization of the Edge Gateway.
If this external network is using IP Spaces, this field can be used to dedicate this external network to the specified Organization.

networkRouteAdvertisementIntention.description:
The different types of route advertisement intentions for routed Org vDC network connected to Edge Gateway that is connected to this Provider Gateway. Possible values are:
  • IP_SPACE_UPLINKS_ADVERTISED_STRICT - All networks within IP Space associated with IP Space Uplink will be advertised by default. This can be changed on an individual network level later, if necessary. All other networks outside of IP Spaces associated with IP Space Uplinks cannot be configured to be advertised.
  • IP_SPACE_UPLINKS_ADVERTISED_FLEXIBLE - All networks within IP Space associated with IP Space Uplink will be advertised by default. This can be changed on an individual network level later, if necessary. All other networks outside of IP Spaces associated with IP Space Uplinks are not advertised by default but can be configured to be advertised after creation.
  • ALL_NETWORKS_ADVERTISED - All networks, regardless on whether they fall inside of any IP Spaces associated with IP Space Uplinks, will be advertised by default. This can be changed on an individual network level later, if necessary.
This only applies to external networks backed by NSX-T Tier-0 router (i.e. Provider Gateway) and is unset otherwise. Public Provider Gateway supports only IP_SPACE_UPLINKS_ADVERTISED_STRICT. All other values are ignored. Private Provider Gateway can support all the intentions and if unset, the default is also IP_SPACE_UPLINKS_ADVERTISED_STRICT.

natAndFirewallServiceIntention.description:
The different types of intentions to configure NAT and firewall rules:
  • PROVIDER_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules only on Provider Gateways.
  • EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules only on Edge Gateways.
  • PROVIDER_AND_EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules on both the Provider and Edge gateways.
This only applies to external networks backed by NSX-T Tier-0 routers (i.e. Provider Gateways) and is unset otherwise. A public Provider Gateway supports only the EDGE_GATEWAY intention. All other values are ignored. Private Provider Gateway can support all the intentions and if unset, the default is EDGE_GATEWAY.

vpnServiceIntention.description:
The different types of intentions to configure IPSec VPN Tunnels:
  • PROVIDER_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec VPN Tunnels only on Provider Gateways. L2 VPN will not be manageable on connected Edge Gateways, as L2 VPN is not currently supported for Provider Gateways.
  • EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec and L2 VPN Tunnels only on Edge Gateways.
  • PROVIDER_AND_EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec VPN Tunnels on both the Provider and Edge Gateways, and L2 VPN on Edge Gateways.
This only applies to external networks backed by NSX-T Tier-0 routers (i.e. Provider Gateways) and is unset otherwise. A public Provider Gateway supports only the EDGE_GATEWAY intention. All other values are ignored. Private Provider Gateway can support all the intentions and if unset, the default is EDGE_GATEWAY.

strictIpMode.description:
When set to true, static manual IPs must come from static IP Pools defined for the network.
Can only be activated when all static manual IPs fall within allocated ranges.
This only applies to external networks backed by NSX-T Segments.

An individual IP or an IP Prefix which is the cause of this violation.
Typically this is a floating IP address or an IP Prefix which is unaccounted for in IP Spaces.
This will be set to NULL if the category is WARNING.

violationMessage.description:
The localized description of the violation. For WARNING category, this will convey the warning message
related to the migration.

category.description:
The category of the violation. Possible values are:
  • FLOATING_IP - For violations related to the floating IP addresses used on Edge Gateways associated with the Provider Gateway.
  • IP_PREFIX - For violations related to the IP Prefixes which are used by the Org vDC networks associated with the Provider Gateway.
  • WARNING - A cautionary violation category which conveys some useful information related to the state of Provider Gateway and its associated entities before the migration. These violations do not block the migration of Provider Gateway.

if IP Prefix is used for network definition.
