BGP AS number to advertise to BGP peers. BGP AS number can be specified in
either ASPLAIN or ASDOT formats, like ASPLAIN format :- '65546', ASDOT format :- '1.10'.

gracefulRestart.description:
BGP Graceful Restart configuration. Not specifying a value results
in default behavior. Read only if using a VRF-Lite backed Provider Gateway.

modeValue.description:
Describes Graceful Restart configuration Modes for BGP configuration on a Provider Gateway. HELPER_ONLY mode is the ability for a BGP speaker to indicate its ability to preserve forwarding state during BGP restart. GRACEFUL_RESTART mode is the ability of a BGP speaker to advertise its restart to its peers.
  • DISABLE - Both graceful restart and helper modes are disabled.
  • HELPER_ONLY - Only helper mode is enabled.
  • GRACEFUL_AND_HELPER - Both graceful restart and helper modes are enabled.
Default is HELPER_ONLY

ProviderGatewayBgpGracefulRestartConfig.description: Describes current graceful restart configuration mode and timer for BGP configuration on a Provider Gateway.

ipSpaceUplinkRef.description:
Reference to the IP Space Uplink configured on the Provider Gateway. This will be used to determine
the IP Space scopes for the filter configurations associated with the auto-configured BGP neighbor.

name.description: Name of an existing or new BGP Permission Group to auto-configure.

neighborAddress.description: The IP address of an existing or new BGP Neighbor to auto-configure. Both IPv4 and IPv6 formats are supported.

remoteASNumber.description: The remote AS number of a BGP neighbor in ASPLAIN or ASDOT format.

ProviderGatewayBgpAutoConfigProperties.description: An object specifying parameters to auto-configure BGP config on the Provider Gateway.

id.description: The identifier of the BGP Permission Group in URN format.

name.description: The name of the BGP Permission Group.

description.description: Description for the BGP Permission Group.

bgpNeighborAccessLevel.description:
The current access level assigned to the BGP neighbors which are part of this Permission Group. Possible values are:
  • TENANT_VIEW - Tenant user can view BGP neighbors which are part of this Permission Group.
  • TENANT_MANAGE - Tenant user can manage BGP neighbors which are part of this Permission Group.
  • NO_ACCESS - Tenant user cannot view or manage BGP neighbors which are part of this Permission Group.

communityListAccessLevel.description:
The current access level assigned to the BGP community lists which are part of this Permission Group. Possible values are:
  • TENANT_VIEW - Tenant user can view BGP community lists which are part of this Permission Group.
  • TENANT_MANAGE - Tenant user can manage BGP community lists which are part of this Permission Group.
  • NO_ACCESS - Tenant user cannot view or manage BGP community lists which are part of this Permission Group.

prefixListAccessLevel.description:
The current access level assigned to the BGP prefix lists which are part of this Permission Group. Possible values are:
  • TENANT_VIEW - Tenant user can view BGP prefix lists which are part of this Permission Group.
  • TENANT_MANAGE - Tenant user can manage BGP prefix lists which are part of this Permission Group.
  • NO_ACCESS - Tenant user cannot view or manage BGP prefix lists which are part of this Permission Group.

routeMapAccessLevel.description:
The current access level assigned to the BGP route maps which are part of this Permission Group. Possible values are:
  • TENANT_VIEW - Tenant user can view BGP route maps which are part of this Permission Group.
  • TENANT_MANAGE - Tenant user can manage BGP route maps which are part of this Permission Group.
  • NO_ACCESS - Tenant user cannot view or manage BGP route maps which are part of this Permission Group.

bgpNeighborMemberCount.description: The number of BGP neighbors which are part of this Permission Group.

communityListMemberCount.description: The number of BGP community lists which are part of this Permission Group.

prefixListMemberCount.description: The number of BGP prefix lists which are part of this Permission Group.

routeMapMemberCount.description: The number of BGP route maps which are part of this Permission Group.

ProviderGatewayBgpPermissionGroup.description:
A BGP Permission Group. For a tenant user to view or manage a specific BGP configuration, the Tenant must have associated BGP rights and the related
BGP components must be part of a Permission Group and the access level for the component must be marked as TENANT_VIEW or TENANT_MANAGE.

ProviderGatewayBgpPermissionGroupMembers.description: A list of BGP Permission Group members.

values.description: All BGP neighbors for a Provider Gateway.

ProviderGatewayBgpNeighbors.description: List of all configured BGP neighbors for a Provider Gateway.

gracefulRestartModeValue.description:
Currently configured graceful restart configuration mode. Default is HELPER_ONLY.
  • DISABLE - Both graceful restart and helper modes are disabled.
  • HELPER_ONLY - Only helper mode is enabled.
  • GRACEFUL_AND_HELPER - Both graceful restart and helper modes are enabled.

bfd.description:
Specifies the BFD configuration for failure detection. Not specifying a value results
in default behavior.

ipAddressTypeFilteringValue.description:
Specifies IP address type based filtering in each direction. Setting the value to 'DISABLED' will disable address family based filtering.
  • IPV4
  • IPV6
  • DISABLED

routeFilteringConfigurations.description: List of address family and route filtering configurations in each direction.

localASNumber.description:
Local AS configuration override for this neighbor. Can be specified in either ASPLAIN or ASDOT formats
like ASPLAIN format :- '65546', ASDOT format :- '1.10'. If set, this neighbor will use this instead of the local AS configuration from
general BGP configuration. This field can be set on Provider Gateway backed by TIER-0 routers or TIER-0 VRFs.

asPathModifierType.description:
Specifies the AS path modifier type to override the default prepend action. If unset, then by default BGP prepends neighbor's local AS number to the AS path for both outgoing and incoming route advertisements from the peer neighbor. This field is ignored if localASNumber is not set.
  • NO_PREPEND - The AS path advertised will only prepend the BGP local AS rather than the neighbor's local AS number.
  • NO_PREPEND_REPLACE_AS - The local routes will be advertised with the neighbor's local AS instead of the BGP local AS.

active.description: Flag to activate/deactivate BGP neighbor peering. The default value is true.

sourceAddresses.description:
Source IP addresses for BGP peering. IP addresses should belong to Tier-0 external, loopback, or VTI interface IP addresses. This field is mandatory if
maximum hop limit is greater than 1.

maxHopLimit.description: Maximum number of hops allowed to reach BGP neighbor. Source IP address must be provided if limit is greater than 1.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.description: Reference to the BGP Permission Group and corresponding access level assigned to this BGP neighbor.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

ProviderGatewayBgpNeighborsStatusList.description: Provider Gateway BGP Neighbors status list.

neighborId.description: The unique id of this BGP neighbor.

edgeNodeRef.description: Reference to the edge transport node.

sourceAddress.description: The IP address of the logical port.

neighborAddress.description: The IP address of the BGP neighbor.

remoteASNumber.description: AS number of the BGP neighbor.

connectionState.description:
Current state of the BGP session. Possible values are:
  • INVALID
  • IDLE
  • CONNECT
  • ACTIVE
  • OPEN_SENT
  • OPEN_CONFIRM
  • ESTABLISHED
  • UNKNOWN

totalInPrefixCount.description: Sum of prefix counts for IN direction across all address families.

totalOutPrefixCount.description: Sum of prefix counts specified for OUT direction across all address families.

localPort.description: TCP port number of the local BGP connection

remotePort.description: TCP port number of the remote BGP connection

messagesReceived.description: Count of messages received from the neighbor

messagesSent.description: Count of messages sent to the neighbor

timeSinceEstablished.description: Time in seconds since connection was established

announcedCapabilities.description: BGP capabilities sent to BGP neighbor

negotiatedCapabilities.description: BGP capabilities negotiated with BGP neighbor

ProviderGatewayBgpNeighborStatus.description: An object representing the status of a Provider Gateway BGP Neighbor.

values.description: IP addresses for BGP Neighbor to establish peering with based on the Provider Gateway's external/loopback interfaces and VTIs.

BgpNeighborSourceAddresses.description: List of BGP Neighbor source IP addresses.

values.description: All Prefix lists.

ProviderGatewayPrefixLists.description: List of all configured Prefix lists for a Provider Gateway.

id.description: The unique id of this prefix list. On updates, the id is required for the list, while for create a new id will be generated. This id is not a VCD URN.

name.description: Name for the prefix list.

description.description: Description for this prefix list.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.description: Reference to the BGP Permission Group and corresponding access level assigned to this prefix list.

ProviderGatewayPrefixList.description:
A list of prefixes for routing purposes. Prefix list contains one or more ordered entries
which are processed sequentially.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

action.description:
Action for the prefix list. This specifies whether the packet from specified network is advertised or not for routing purposes. Default is 'PERMIT'.
  • PERMIT
  • DENY

ProviderGatewayPrefixListEntry.description: A network prefix entry used for routing purposes.

id.description: The identifier of the BGP Permission Group in URN format.

name.description: The name of the BGP Permission Group.

accessLevel.description:
The access level assigned to the BGP component in the referenced Permission Group. Possible values are:
  • TENANT_VIEW - Tenant user can view the component.
  • TENANT_MANAGE - Tenant user can manage the component.
  • NO_ACCESS - Tenant user cannot view or manage the component.

ProviderGatewayBgpPermissionGroupReferen.description:
A BGP Permission Group reference associated with a BGP component. It specifies the the BGP Permission Group along with
the access level assigned to the component.

ProviderGatewayCommunityListSummaries.description: List of configured BGP community entries for a Provider Gateway.

firstFiveCommunities.description: List of the first five BGP community entry names for the Community List.

ProviderGatewayCommunityListSummary.description: A summary model object for Provider Gateway Community List.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

communities.description:
List of BGP community entries. Both regular and large communities are supported. Regular community format: aa:nn where aa and nn must
be within the range [1 - 65536]. Large BGP Community format: aa:bb:nn where aa (Global Administrator), bb (Local Data Part 1) and nn (Local Data Part 2)
must be within the range [1 - 4294967295]. In addition to numbered communities (e.g. 3356:2040),
predefined communities (NO_EXPORT, NO_ADVERTISE, NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED) are also supported. For multiple community types, only the combination of regular 
and predefined communities is allowed.

ProviderGatewayCommunityList.description: Represents a list of communities for routing purposes.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

ProviderGatewayRouteMapSummaries.description: List of configured Route Maps on a Provider Gateway.

matchCriteriaCount.description: Number of match criteria entries in this Route Map.

ProviderGatewayRouteMapSummary.description: A summary model object for Provider Gateway Route Map.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

matchCriteriaEntries.description: An ordered list of matching criteria entries of the Route Map.

ProviderGatewayRouteMap.description:
Represents a Route Map object. A Route Map specifies the mappings for
redistributing routes to BGP and other routing protocols.

bgpPermissionGroupRef.x-vcloud-restricted: restricted field, requires "Provider Gateway Routing View" right to access this field.

bgpRedistributionActive.description: A flag indicating if route redistribution for BGP is active or not.

redistributionRules.description: The list of Route Redistribution Rules

ProviderGatewayRouteRedistributionConfig.description: Specifies the Provider Gateway route redistribution configuration

name.description: Name for the Route Redistribution Rule.

routeMapRef.description: The Route Map to associate with the Route Redistribution Rule.

ProviderGatewayRouteRedistributionRule.description: A Route Redistribution Rule to specify the redistribution rule name, services, and route map.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnels.description: List of GRE Tunnels on the Provider Gateway.

id.description:
The unique ID of this GRE tunnel. On updates, the ID is required for the object, while for create a new ID will be generated.
This ID is not a VCD URN.

name.description: The name of the tunnel.

description.description: Description of the tunnel.

destinationAddress.description: The destination IP Address of the tunnel. IPv4 only.

tunnelAddresses.description:
The tunnel addresses of the tunnel.
Specifies the source IP address to use per edge node, for the tunnel interface.
Supports IPv4 and IPv6.

active.description: Whether the tunnel is active. If set to null, will use the default value.

mtu.description: The maximum transmission unit (in bytes) of the tunnel. If set to null, will use the default value.

keepAlive.description: The keep-alive configuration of the tunnel. A health-check for tunnel connectivity. If set to null, will use default values.

realizedState.description: The realized state of the GRE tunnel in the backing network provider.

aggregatedConnectivityStatus.description:
The connectivity status of the GRE Tunnel, aggregated across Tunnel Addresses (edge nodes). One of the following:
  • UP
  • DOWN
  • UNKNOWN

ProviderGatewayGreTunnel.description: Information about the GRE Tunnel on the Provider Gateway.

sourceAddress.description: The source IP Address for this tunnel local endpoint. IPv4 only.

edgeNodeRef.description: The edge node reference where this tunnel local endpoint will be realized.

tunnelInterfaces.description:
The IP Addresses in CIDR notation assigned to the tunnel interface on this edge node.
Maximum of one IPv4 and two IPv6 subnets.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelAddress.description: The Tunnel Address of the tunnel.

active.description: Whether to send tunnel keep-alive checks.

sendAck.description: Whether to send a keep-alive acknowledge for received keep-alive checks.

deadMultiplier.description:
The allowed number of consecutive, sent, keep-alive checks with no response or error
before changing the tunnel status to down.

interval.description: The number of seconds between sending every keep-alive check.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelKeepAlive.description: The keep-alive of the tunnel. Properties set to null will use their default value.

status.description:
Represents current status of the networking entity. Possible values are:
  • PENDING - Desired entity configuration has been received by system and is pending realization.
  • CONFIGURING - The system is in process of realizing the entity.
  • REALIZED - The entity is successfully realized in the system.
  • REALIZATION_FAILED - There are some issues and the system is not able to realize the entity.
  • UNKNOWN - Current state of entity is unknown.

NetworkingEntityStatus.description: Represents status of a networking entity.

destinationAddress.description: The destination IP Address of the tunnel. IPv4 only.

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 date string reflecting the time the statistics were last updated.

transmittedStatistics.description: Statistics for transmitted traffic of the GRE Tunnel.

receivedStatistics.description: Statistics for received traffic of the GRE Tunnel.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelTrafficStatistic.description: Traffic Statistics for a GRE Tunnel, either for received (RX) or transmitted (TX) traffic.

destinationAddress.description: The destination address of the GRE Tunnel.

tunnelAddressStatuses.description: The connectivity status of the GRE Tunnel for each Tunnel Address.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelConnectivityStat.description: The connectivity status of the GRE Tunnel, for each Tunnel Address. Also includes tunnel keep-alive statistics.

edgeNodeRef.description: The edge node reference where this tunnel local endpoint is realized.

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 date string reflecting the time the statistics were last updated.

sourceAddress.description: The source IP of the Tunnel Address. IPv4 only.

connectivityStatus.description:
The connectivity status of the GRE Tunnel for this Tunnel Address. One of the following:
  • UP
  • DOWN
  • UNKNOWN

tunnelUpCount.description: The number of times (and last time) the connectivity status has changed to UP.

tunnelDownCount.description: The number of times (and last time) the connectivity status has changed to DOWN.

keepAliveState.description:
The keep-alive setting of the GRE Tunnel. One of the following:
  • ACTIVE
  • INACTIVE
  • UNKNOWN

keepAliveTransmittedCount.description: The number of times (and last time) a keep-alive check was sent (TX).

keepAliveReceivedCount.description: The number of times (and last time) a keep-alive check was received (RX).

keepAliveAckCount.description: The number of times (and last time) a received keep-alive check (RX) was responded to with an ACK.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelAddressConnectiv.description: The connectivity status of the GRE Tunnel for a Tunnel Address.

eventCount.description: The number of times this event has occurred.

lastOccurrenceTime.description: ISO-8601 date string representing the last time this event occurred.

ProviderGatewayGreTunnelConnectivityStat.description:
A count of an event, and the last (most recent) time this event occurred.
Either for a tunnel connectivity status change, or a keep-alive packet sent/received/acknowledged.

ipSpaceRef.description:
Reference to the IP Space that will be used to create an uplink and determine the scopes for the
filter configurations associated with the auto-configured BGP neighbor.

name.description: Name of the new route-based IPsec VPN tunnel to auto-configure.

remoteEndpoint.description: IP address of the remote endpoint on the remote site. This is the Public IP address of the remote device terminating the VPN tunnel.

localEndpoint.description: The IP address for the endpoint. For a gateway using an IP Space, the IP must be allocated if it falls within the IP Space.

preSharedKey.description: This is the pre-shared key used for authentication.

localTunnelInterfaces.description:
Virtual Tunnel Interfaces (VTI), the local interface that the tunnel traffic is routed through. The list can be a single IPv4 CIDR, a single IPv6 CIDR,
or one of each. The local VTIs must be in the same subnet as the remote VTIs.

remoteTunnelIpAddresses.description:
IP addresses of the remote tunnel VTIs. The list can be a single IPv4 address, a single IPv6 address,
or one of each. IP addresses must be in the same subnet as the local VTIs. BGP neighbors will be autoconfigured
with the provided IP addresses.

bgpNeighborRemoteAsNumber.description: The remote AS number for the autoconfigured BGP neighbor in ASPLAIN or ASDOT format.

bgpNeighborLocalAsNumber.description: The local AS number override for the autoconfigured BGP neighbor in ASPLAIN or ASDOT format.

GatewayIpSecVpnAutoConfigProperties.description: An object specifying parameters to auto-configure a route-based IPsec VPN tunnel on the Provider Gateway.

NetworkPool.description:
A network pool is a group of undifferentiated networks that is available
for use within an organization vDC to create certain type of vDC networks
such as Organization vDC and Cross vDC networks.

NetworkPoolsSummary.description: List of Network Pool Summary Objects.

totalBackingsCount.description: The number of backings available for use.

NetworkPoolProjection.description: An object representing details of a network pool projection to an organization.

id.description: The id of the Application Port Profile in URN format.

name.description: The name of the Application Port Profile.

scope.description: The scope of the application port profile definition.

applicationPorts.description: A list of protocol and ports supported by this application port profile.

usableForNAT.description:
True means that the port profile can be used for NAT configuration.  A port profile can be used for NAT if there is only 1 application port
with at most 1 destination port.

ApplicationPortProfile.description: An Application Port Profile object. The application port profile represents a set of ports and protocols that can be used when defining network service rules.

id.description: The unique id of this network context profile in URN format.

name.description: Name for the network context profile.

description.description: Description for the network context profile.

scope.description: The scope of the network context profile.

attributes.description: Array of network context profile attributes.

NetworkContextProfile.description:
Describes a networking context profile. Context profiles are groups of similar type of
values where each value specifies some layer 7 App Id, or Domain Name.

attributes.description: Array of network context profile attributes.

NetworkContextProfileAttributes.description: A wrapper object for an array of network context profile attributes.

type.description:
This describes the type of attribute value.
  • APP_ID - Values represents layer 7 App Ids. For example: ACTIVDIR
  • DOMAIN_NAME - Values represents Domain names (FQDN). For example: *.live.com

values.description: Values for attribute.

subAttributes.description:
List of sub attributes for an attribute. These are specified with the attributes
such as SSL or CIFS, which can have different cipher suites or TLS versions
as values.

NetworkContextProfileAttribute.description:
Describes an attribute of a networking context profile. An attribute
is defined as a type and its associated values for some layer 7 App Id or Domain names.

type.description: This describes the type of sub attribute's values.

values.description: Values for sub attribute.

NetworkContextProfileSubAttribute.description: Describes a sub attribute of a networking context profile attribute.

ipAddresses.description: IP Addresses included in the group. This is only applicable for IP_SET Firewall Groups. This can support IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in single, range, and CIDR formats.

macAddresses.description: The MAC Addresses included in the group. This is only applicable for MAC_SET Firewall Groups.

members.description:
The list of static member entities such as Org vDC Networks to be used. This is only applicable for STATIC_MEMBERS Firewall Groups.
The objects used must be scoped to the particular Edge Gateway / vDC Group specified.

vmCriteria.description:
The list of dynamic criteria that determines whether a VM belongs to a firewall group.  A VM needs to meet at least one criteria to belong to the
firewall group. In other words, the logical AND is used for rules within a single criteria and the logical OR is used in between each criteria.
This is only applicable for VM_CRITERIA Firewall Groups.

FirewallGroupAssociatedVMs.description: List of associated VMs for firewall group

id.description: A unique identifier for the pvdc.

name.description: The name of the pvdc.

description.description: The description of the pvdc.

isEnabled.description: Whether the pvdc is enabled or not.

memoryCapacityMB.description:
Total memory resources in MB available to this PVDC. Null means UNLIMITED memory.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
memory capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the memory capacity projected to this organization.

memoryReservationCapacityMB.description:
Total memory reservation resources in MB available to this PVDC.
Null means UNLIMITED memory reservation resources.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
memory reservation capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the memory reservation capacity projected to this organization.

cpuCapacityMHz.description:
Total CPU resources in MHz available to this PVDC.
Null means UNLIMITED CPU resources.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
CPU capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the CPU capacity projected to this organization.

cpuReservationCapacityMHz.description:
Total CPU reservation resources in MHz available to this PVDC.
Null means UNLIMITED CPU reserved resources.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
CPU reservation capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the CPU reservation capacity projected to this organization.

maxVcpuSpeedMHz.description:
Maximum vCPU speed allowed in this PVDC. Null means no restriction.
When defined, this field acts as a barrier for vCPU speed defined in
each VDC created from this PVDC.
Example: If this field value is 2000, then in this PVDC, no VDC can
be created with a vCPU speed higher than 2000.

maxSupportedHwVersion.description: The maximum hardware version this pvdc supports.

creationStatus.description: The creation status of the Provider VDC. Possible values are READY, NOT_READY, ERROR, FAILED_CREATION.

nsxTManager.description: The NSX-T manager of the pvdc, if any.

vimServer.description: The vCenter server the pvdc belongs to.

cross-reference.description:
A filter to look up provider vdcs that are projected to a specific org
Example usage:
filter=isProjectedToOrg==urn:vcloud:organization:<uuid>

totalMemoryMB.description:
The total memory capacity in MB of the underlying physical infrastructure.
For sub provider organizations this field indicates the total memory capacity
that is provided by using Provider VDC projection mechanism.
A value of NULL represents unlimited memory capacity in sub provider organizations.

totalMemoryReservationMB.description:
Total memory reservation capacity in MB of the underlying physical infrastructure.
For sub provider organizations this field indicates the total memory reservation capacity
that is provided by using Provider VDC projection mechanism.
A value of NULL represents unlimited memory reservation in sub provider organizations.

memoryCommittedMB.description:
Total memory in MB allocated from this PVDC to tenants and their VDCs.
When looking at this field from System organization, this field
includes all the memory allocation that is provided to sub provider
organizations by using Provider VDC projection mechanism and the
total memory allocated from this PVDC to all the VDCs and all the
deployed VMs in Pay As You Go and FLEX with zero allocation (mimicking PAYGO)
type of VDCs in organizations directly managed by System organization.
When looking at this metric from an organization's context that has a projection
created from this PVDC, the field's value represents the total memory in MB allocated 
to all the VDCs and all deployed VMs in FLEX mimicking PAYGO type of VDCs from 
this PVDCs in this organization.

memoryReservationCommittedMB.description:
Total memory in MB reserved from this PVDC to tenants and their VDCs.
When looking at this field from System organization, this field
includes all the memory reservation that is provided to sub provider
organizations by using Provider VDC projection mechanism and the
total memory reservation from this PVDC to all the VDCs and all the
deployed VMs in Pay As You GO and FLEX with zero allocation (mimicking PAYGO) 
type of VDCs in organizations directly managed by System organization.
When looking at this metric from an organization's context that has a projection
created from this PVDC, the field's value represents the total memory in MB reserved 
to all the VDCs and all deployed VMs in FLEX mimicking PAYGO type of VDCs
from this PVDCs in this organization

memoryReservationUsedMB.description:
Total memory reservation in MB used by all the VDCs VMs from this PVDC
when queried without any organization context.
When looking at this metric from an organization's context that
has a projection created from this PVDC, the field's value
represents the total memory reservation used by deployed virtual machines
from this PVDC in this organization.

memoryUsedMB.description:
Total memory reservation in MB used by all the VDCs from this PVDC
when queried without any organization context.
When looking at this field from an organization's context that has
a projection created from this PVDC, this field represents the
total memory in MB allocated to all the deployed VMs from this PVDC
in this organization.

memoryOverheadMB.description:
Total memory overhead in this PVDC. Includes memory overhead of
all running VMs in this PVDC and also memory consumed in System vDC.
When looking at this field from an organization's context that has
a projection created from this PVDC, this field's value is always zero.

totalCpuMHz.description:
The total CPU capacity in MHz of the underlying physical infrastructure.
For sub provider organizations this field indicates the total CPU capacity
that is provided by using Provider VDC projection mechanism.
A value of NULL represents unlimited CPU capacity in sub provider organizations.

that is provided by using Provider VDC projection mechanism.

Total CPU reservation in MHz used by all the VDCs from this PVDC
when queried without any organization context.
When looking at this metric from an organization's context that

represents the total CPU reservation used by deployed virtual machines
from this PVDC in this organization.

Total CPU reservation in MHz used by all the running VMs from this PVDC
when queried without any organization context.
When looking at this field from an organization's context that has
a projection created from this PVDC, this field represents the
total CPU in MHz allocated to all the deployed VMs from this PVDC
in this organization.

Total CPU overhead in this PVDC. Includes CPU resources consumed
in the System vDC associated to this PVDC. When looking at this
field from an organization's context that has a projection

memory reservation capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the memory reservation capacity projected to this organization. If non-null,
the minimum value is 0 MB.

Null means UNLIMITED CPU resources.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
CPU capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the CPU capacity projected to this organization. If non-null, the minimum
value is 1 MHz.

cpuReservationCapacityMHz.description:

Null means UNLIMITED CPU reserved resources.
For provider VDCs seen from System organization, this field represents the actual
CPU reservation capacity of the Clusters/Resource Pools backing this PVDC.
For PVDCs seen from a sub-provider Organization's context, this field shows
the CPU reservation capacity projected to this organization. If non-null,
the minimum value is 0 MHz.

maxVcpuSpeedMHz.description:
Maximum vCPU speed in MHz allowed in this PVDC. Null means no restriction.
When defined, this field acts as a barrier for vCPU speed defined in
each VDC created from this PVDC. If non-null, the minimum value is 1000 MHz.
Example: If this field value is 2000, then in this PVDC, no VDC can
be created with a vCPU speed higher than 2000.

Upon retrieving the certificate chain presented during the handshake, if signing CA certificates were not included, but a location is specified for the 'caIssuers' access method of the 'Authority Info Access' extension (as described in RFC 5280 Section 4.2.2.1) of those certificates and that location is one of these supplied URLs, then additional certificates will be retrieved from those URLs in accordance with the protocol laid out in the RFC.

Any failure to retrieve this certificate will NOT fail the test connection request, nor will the error associated with this failure be returned.

In the unlikely event that the CA Issuers URL specifies `https` instead of `http`, the original certificate, that included that URL, will be temporarily used to trust the server during ssl handshake

state.description:
Every entity is created in the "PRE_CREATED" state. Once an entity is ready to be
validated against its schema, it will transition in another state - RESOLVED, if the
entity is valid according to the schema, or RESOLUTION_ERROR otherwise. If an entity in
an "RESOLUTION_ERROR" state is updated, it will transition to the initial "PRE_CREATED"
state without performing any validation. If its in the "RESOLVED" state, then it will
be validated against the entity type schema and throw an exception if its invalid.

entityState.description:
The "entityState" field may have the following values: "PRE_CREATED", "RESOLVED",
"RESOLUTION_ERROR", "IN_DELETION". Every entity is created in the "PRE_CREATED" state. Once an entity is
ready to be validated against its schema, it will transition in another state - "RESOLVED",
if the entity is valid according to the schema, or "RESOLUTION_ERROR" otherwise. If an entity in
an "RESOLUTION_ERROR" state is updated, it will transition to the initial "PRE_CREATED"
state without performing any validation. If its in the "RESOLVED" state, then it will
be validated against the entity type schema and throw an exception if its invalid.
Once an entity is ready to be deleted, if any external resources need to be cleaned up,
the entity deletion process can be set up into multiple stages. The entity will transition
into state IN_DELETION when the finalization process starts and will be permanently deleted
once it completes successfully. If the finalization is not successful, the entity will
once it completes successfully. If the finalization is not successful, the entity will
remain in IN_DELETION state.

In the case of external services, the url matcher will only match requests under /api.
In the case of external endpoints, the url matcher will match requests under /ext-api, /ext-ui/provider and
/ext-ui/tenant/{tenantName}.

UrlMatcher.description:
The UrlMatcher consists of urlPattern and urlScope which together identify a URL which will be serviced by
an external system. For example, if you want the external system to service all requests matching '/ext-api/custom/.*',
the URL Matcher object should be:
{
  "urlPattern": "/custom/.*",
  "urlScope": "EXT_API"
}
It is important to note that in the case of EXT_UI_TENANT urlScope, the tenant name is not part of the urlPattern. The
urlPattern will match the request after the tenant name - if request is "/ext-ui/tenant/testOrg/custom/test", the pattern
will match against "/custom/test".

restricted when catalogContentSource is of 'sourceType' = 'VmwareMarketplace'. In that

needLocalCopy.description: Whether to download content from publisher and store it locally.

isDistributed.description: Boolean to indicate whether the catalog is distributed or not.

isReadOnly.description: If true, the catalog is not allowed to write new content to the underlying storage.

distributedCatalogId.description:
UUID of an existing distributed catalog. This field can only be provided
at catalog creation time to bind new catalog to an existing
distributed catalog system identified by given identifier.
This field cannot be changed once the catalog
is created. If the value is not provided during catalog creation, then
system generates a new distributed catalog id for this catalog if

An object representing Distributed Catalog settings.
A Distributed Catalog is a special kind of catalog that uses
distributed storage to store its items.

appType.description:
Type of template. This is a discriminator field that helps in distinguishing the type of
template this object represents. If the template is an image of a container application,
the value of this field is ContainerAppTemplate. If the template is an image of a virtual
machine or a collection of virtual machines then the value of this field is
VmAppTemplate. If the template is an image of a media item then the value of this field
is MediaAppTemplate.

id.description: A unique identifier for the appTemplate.

appId.description:
A unique identifier to globally identify this appTemplate. Items sourced
from an external source such as VMware Marketplace have their appId referenced
by the unique id in that external source. This means an item sourced from an external
source in two different catalogs will still have the same appId.

catalogContentSource.description:
Identifier of CatalogContentSource that is used to fetch this item.
This is immutable and cannot be changed after creation. Can be null if the item was
not imported from an external source.

name.description: The name of the appTemplate.

description.description: The description of the appTemplate.

creationDate.description:
The date and time when this appTemplate was created.
This value will be formatted as per ISO 8601 format and include timezone information.

lastUpdateDate.description:
The date and time representing when this appTemplate was last updated.
This value will be formatted as per ISO 8601 format and include timezone information.

status.description: Status indicating whether this appTemplate is ready or not.

logoUrl.description: URL of the logo of this application.

screenshotUrls.description: List of screenshot URLs of the application.

eulaAccepted.description:
Accepts EULA for all the application versions that are part of this AppTemplate.
The field is required only if appTemplate is created from VMware Marketplace.
For other type of catalog content sources, this field is optional.

owner.description: The reference to the user that created this item.

catalog.description: The reference to the catalog that this AppTemplate belongs to.

org.description:
The reference to the organization that the AppTemplate belongs to.
This is a read-only field.

lastUpdatedSiteId.description:
ID of the site which last modified this app template. The site is not necessarily a
site which was paired via multi-site pairing. It is simply used to identify another
VCD instance.

lastUpdatedSiteName.description:
Name of the site which last modified this app template. The site is not necessarily a
site which was paired via multi-site pairing. It is simply used to identify another
VCD instance.

app this object represents. If the app is running in Kubernetes cluster, the value of this field
is ContainerApp. If the app is running in a virtual machine or a collection of virtual machines then
this the value of this field is VmApp.

id.description: A unique identifier for the app.

appTemplateId.description: An identifier to the appTemplate from which this app is created.

The name of the app. If the app is ContainerApp, the value of this field must consist of
lowercase alphanumeric characters or '-', start with an alphabetic character,
and end with an alphanumeric character.

description.description: The description of the app.

creationDate.description:

This value will be formatted as per ISO 8601 format and include timezone information.

status.description: Status indicating whether this app is ready or not.

logoUrl.description: URL of the logo of this application.

screenshotUrls.description: List of screenshot URLs of the App.

owner.description: The reference to the user that owns this item.

org.description: The reference to the organization that the App belongs to

vdc.description:
The reference to the organization virtual data center that the App belongs to.
This is not a mandatory field. If VDC is not provided, system will pick a VDC
randomly to access resources for the application.

eulaAccepted.description:
Accepts EULA for the application version this App is launched from.
If one application is protected by EULA, app creation, upgrade and downgrade requires
to accept the EULA for the target application version.

App.description: An object representing a VCD App.

KubernetesResources.description: List of Kubernetes resources allocated for a container app.

revision.description:
The revision number of current revision. Container app's first revision will be
numbered with 1, and this number will be increased by 1 for each new revision.

appVersion.description:
Container app's application version. During revision generation, Cloud Director
will persist the value of App's appVersion field into this field.

packageInfo.description: Package information of the container app during revision generation.

state.description:
State indicating whether this app is accepted or not. Possible values are:
  • IN_DRAFT - The container app is in a paused state and the revision contains the draft edit on container app.
  • SUBMITTED - The container app revision has been submitted.
  • ACCEPTED - The container app revision has been accepted by Cloud Director.
  • REJECTED - The container app revision has been rejected by Cloud Director.
  • CANCELED - The container app revision has been dropped due to a rollover update on container.

message.description:
Detailed message of the container app during revision generation. Cloud Director will use this field to
report back the reason why one container app revision was rejected.

creationDate.description:
The date and time when this revision was created.
An ISO-8601 timestamp generated by the server when a key is added, and this value is immutable and cannot be
changed after creation.

owner.description: The reference to the user that creates this revision.

ContainerAppRevision.description:
A revision for a container based App. The first revision is generated automatically
during container app creation. Upgrade / downgrade container app's version, change
its custom values, or rollback a container app will also generate a new revision.

type.description: The package type.

version.description:
The package type specific version used to deploy the container app.
E.g. for a helm chart package, we should use helm chart's chart version.

customValuesCheckSum.description:
The SHA-256 checksum of the custom changes applied to override default values in
values.yaml.
This field will be null if there's no custom changes applied.

PackageInfo.description: Package information used to deploy a container app.

scope.description:
Not configurable by the client. A fixed list of the following six scope values:
  • openid - as required per the OpenID Connect Core spec
  • profile - as described in the OpenID Connect Core spec
  • email - as described in the OpenID Connect Core spec
  • phone - as described in the OpenID Connect Core spec
  • groups - grants access to the groups claims.
  • vcd_idp - grants access to the roles, org_id, org_display_name, and org_name claims.

memoryMB.description: Memory in MB that a node gets when this VirtualMachineClass is applied to the node of a Kubernetes cluster.

VirtualMachineClass.description: In a Tanzu Kubernetes cluster Virtual Machine Classes reserve a set of resources for the VM including cpu, memory, and storage.

id.description: The id of the candidate vDC.

name.description: The name of the candidate vDC.

orgRef.description: The reference to the organization this vDC is in.

siteRef.description: The site ID that this vDC belongs to.

networkProviderScope.description: The network provider scope of the vDC.

faultDomainTag.description:
Represents the fault domain of a given organization vDC. For NSX_V backed organization vDCs, this is the network provider scope.
For NSX_T backed organization vDCs, this can vary (for example name of the provider vDC or compute provider scope).

NetworkingCandidateVdc.description: A candidate vDC that can be added to a vDC Group.

cross-reference.description:
A filter to include all vDCs in managed organizations that are candidates for the vDC Group.
This is only supported for vDC Groups backed by an NSX-T network provider. Default value is false.
Example usage:
includeVdcsInManagedOrgs==true

Includes, or excludes, vDCs already participating in the vDC Group. Has no effect if a vDC Group is not specified in the query. The following filter values are supported:
  • true - includes already participating vDCs. This is the default behavior if this filter is not specified.
  • false - excludes already participating vDCs.

This is only supported for vDC Groups backed by an NSX-T network provider. Example usage: includeParticipatingVdcs==false

id.description:
The unique id of this firewall rule. If a rule with the ruleId
is not already present, a new rule will be created. If it already
exists, the rule will be updated.

name.description: Name for the rule.

sourceFirewallGroups.description:
List of source groups for firewall rule. It specifies the sources of network traffic for the firewall rule.
Null values in both this property and sourceFirewallIpAddresses will be treated as "ANY"
For Distributed Firewall rules, an entry with an id of urn:vcloud:firewallGroup:internal can be used to specify all internal vDC Group network traffic.

sourceFirewallIpAddresses.description:
List of source IP addresses, IP Ranges, or CIDRs. This specifies the source of the traffic which the firewall rule will be applied to
Null values in both this property and sourceFirewallGroups will be treated as "ANY"

destinationFirewallGroups.description:
List of destination groups for firewall rule. It specifies the destinations of network traffic for the firewall rule.
Null values in both this property and destinationFirewallIpAddresses will be treated as "ANY"
For Distributed Firewall rules, an entry with an id of urn:vcloud:firewallGroup:internal can be used to specify all internal vDC Group network traffic.

destinationFirewallIpAddresses.description:
List of destination IP addresses, IP ranges, or CIDRs. This specifies the destination of the traffic which the firewall rule will be applied to
Null values in both this property and destinationFirewallGroups will be treated as "ANY"

applicationPortProfiles.description:
The list of application ports where this firewall rule is applicable.
Null value or an empty list will be treated as "ANY" which means rule applies to all ports.

ipProtocol.description:
Type of IP packet that should be matched while enforcing the rule.
Default value is IPV4_IPV6.

action.description:
The action to be applied to all the traffic that meets the firewall rule criteria.
It determines if the rule permits or blocks traffic. This property is now deprecated and replaced with actionValue.
Property is required if actionValue is not set.

actionValue.description:
The action to be applied to all the traffic that meets the firewall rule criteria. It determines if the rule permits or blocks traffic. Property is required if action is not set. Below are valid values.
  • ALLOW permits traffic to go through the firewall.
  • DROP blocks the traffic at the firewall. No response is sent back to the source.
  • REJECT blocks the traffic at the firewall. A response is sent back to the source.

direction.description:
Specifies the direction of the network traffic.
Default value is IN_OUT.

logging.description: Whether packet logging is enabled for firewall rule.

networkContextProfiles.description:
The list of layer 7 network context profiles where this firewall rule is applicable.
Null value or an empty list will be treated as "ANY" which means rule applies to all applications and domains.

enabled.description: Whether the firewall rule is enabled.

comments.description: Text for user entered comments on the firewall rule. Length cannot exceed 2048 characters.

appliedTo.description: Used to limit application of this firewall rule to the specified Org VDC or segment backed external network. Only networks connected as service interfaces are usable.

loggingId.description: Unique ID assigned by the backing NSX-T network provider. Passed all the way down to the datapath, and is used for logging by NSX-T. Only applies to NSX-T.

relativePosition.description:
Defines the position of this rule relative to the specified adjacent rule.

On creation requests, if the field is null, the rule is placed at the top of the list of existing rules.
On update requests, if field is null, the rule position is not modified.
On read/get requests, this field is unset.

FirewallRuleIpProtocol.description:
Specifies the IP protocol for the network packet that should be matched while enforcing the rule.
IPV4_IPV6 means both IPV4 and IPV6 packet type.

FirewallRuleAction.description: Defines the firewall rule action to be applied.

FirewallRuleDirection.description: Defines direction of traffic for firewall rule.

id.description: The unique ID for the network. This field is read-only.

name.description: The name of the network.

description.description: The description of the network.

subnets.description: List of subnets configured for the network.

Subnets.description: List of Subnets of a network

prefixLength.description: The prefix length of the subnet.

dnsSuffix.description: The DNS suffix that VMs attached to this network will use.

dnsServer1.description: The first DNS server that VMs attached to this network will use.

dnsServer2.description: The second DNS server that VMs attached to this network will use.

ipRanges.description: Range of IPs within the subnet that can be used in this network. A VM attached to this network is assigned one of these IPs.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the external network subnet is currently enabled.

totalIpCount.description: The number of IP addresses defined by the static IP ranges.

usedIpCount.description: The number of IP address used from the static IP ranges.

Subnet.description: A network subnet defined by its gateway,

uplinkId.description: The identifier of the external network/provider gateway this edge gateway is connected to.

uplinkName.description: The name of the external network/provider gateway this edge gateway is connected to.

subnets.description: Set of subnets this edge will have access to.

connected.description: Whether or not the gateway is connected to this uplink. This value defaults to true if it is not set. When filtering by this field, if the filter is false, all gateways that have 0 connected uplinks will be returned, while if it is true, all gateways with at least one connected uplink will be returned.

quickAddAllocatedIpCount.description: If set on create or update api calls, the specified number of IP addresses will be additionally allocated for this uplink. IPs will be allocated from multiple subnets if needed.

dedicated.description:
This property can be set to make the provider gateway be exclusively used by this edge gateway.
This property is read-only for Provider gateways using IP Space. If the associated provider gateway is using
IP Spaces, user can update the provider gateway itself to dedicate it to the Organization. Provider gateways
using IP Spaces cannot be dedicated to an Edge Gateway.

usingIpSpace.description: This fields is read-only and is set to true if the provider gateway backing the uplink (external network) is using IP Space; else, false.

natAndFirewallServiceIntention.description:
The different types of NAT and firewall Rules intentions being used by the Provider Gateway backing the uplink:
  • PROVIDER_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules only on Provider Gateways.
  • EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules only on Edge Gateways.
  • PROVIDER_AND_EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of NAT and firewall rules on both the Provider and Edge gateways.
This only applies if the Provider Gateway backing the Uplink is using IP Spaces; else, the value is unset.

vpnServiceIntention.description:
The different types of IPSec and L2 VPN intentions being used by the Provider Gateway backing the uplink:
<li> PROVIDER_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec VPN Tunnels only on Provider Gateways. L2 VPN will not be manageable on connected Edge
Gateways, as L2 VPN is not currently supported for Provider Gateways.
<li> EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec and L2 VPN Tunnels only on Edge Gateways.
<li> PROVIDER_AND_EDGE_GATEWAY - Allow management of IPSec VPN Tunnels on both the Provider and Edge Gateways, and L2 VPN on Edge Gateways.
This only applies if the Provider Gateway backing the Uplink is using IP Spaces; else, the value is unset.

vrfLiteBacked.description: Whether the associated external network is backed by a NSX-T VRF-Lite Tier-0.

backingType.description: Type of backing for the network this interface is connected to. Can be NSXT_TIER0, NSXT_VRF_TIER0 or IMPORTED_T_LOGICAL_SWITCH

EdgeGatewayUplink.description: The uplink (i.e. external network/provider gateway) that the edge gateway is connected to. This also contains the external network IPs that are allocated to the edge.

dedicated.x-vcloud-deprecated-alternative: Please use external network/provider gateway API to use IP Space and use the dedicatedOrg property.

primaryIp.description:
The primary IP address allocated for this subnet. If not specified, this IP is auto-allocated.  This IP belongs to the external network
and can be used for system-configured NAT rules such as DNS forwarder configuration.

autoAllocateIpRanges.description: Used for create and update api calls. If set to true, IP Ranges are automatically generated based on totalIpCount.

EdgeGatewaySubnet.description: Subnet for edge gateway that contains the IPs from the external network that are allocated to the edge.

backingId.description: The identifier of the edge gateways backing router.

gatewayType.description: The type of the gateway. Describes if this is an NSX-T edge gateway or an NSX-V edge gateway.

networkProvider.description: The backing network provider, either NSX-T or NSX-V.

isUniversalVdcGroupEdge.description: True if the Edge Gateway belongs to a VDC Group.

networkingTenancyEnabled.description: True if the Edge Gateway is using networking tenancy in the backing networking provider.

EdgeGatewayBacking.description: The backing details of the edge gateway

EdgeGatewayType.description: The type of the edge gateway.

primaryEdgeCluster.description:
This represents the Primary Edge Cluster used for the gateway.
For NSX-T Edges, this means the Edge Cluster the Tier 1 SR resides on. The user should
specify the ID of the NSX-T edge cluster as the value of primaryEdgeCluster's backingId.
For NSX-V Edges, this means the primary appliance for the gateway.

secondaryEdgeCluster.description:
This represents the Secondary Edge Cluster used for the gateway.
It is applicable for NSX-V Edges when High Availability is enabled. If HA
is enabled and no secondary edge cluster is specified, both appliances will be
deployed on the primary edge cluster. If there is a specific secondary edge cluster,
the standby/secondary appliance will be deployed on the secondary edge cluster.
For NSX-T Edges, the value of secondaryEdgeCluster should be set to NULL.

secondaryEdgeClusters.description:
Secondary edge clusters for a NSX-T Universal VDC Group. Up to 3 secondary clusters is supported.
At least one Edge Cluster per local NSX-T manager in the VDC Group must be present.

GatewayEdgeClusterConfig.description: Represents the Edge Cluster Configuration for a given Edge Gateway.

edgeClusterRef.description: The reference to VCD Edge Cluster.

backingId.description:
The Id of the edge cluster in NSX-T manager. The user should
specify the id of NSX-T edge cluster during edge gateway create/update.
VCD will automatically create a corresponding VCD Edge cluster object
referencing the specified NSX-T edge cluster.
For NSX-V Edges, this is set to NULL.

networkProviderScope.description: The network provider scope of the cluster. For NSX-V Edges, this is set to NULL. Can be used in conjunction with backingId for updating NSX-T edge clusters.

nsxTManagerRef.description: The backing NSX-T manager reference. For NSX-V Edges, this is set to NULL.

GatewayEdgeClusterReference.description: This represents the reference to an Edge Cluster used for the gateway.

networkRef.description: The external network that this IP Address belongs to.

category.description: The catagory that an IP can be used for.

GatewayUsedIpAddress.description: Describes an IP address currently be used by the edge gateway. The IP belongs to the IPs allocated to the edge.

GatewayUsedIpAddressCategory.description: The categories that an IP can be used for.

name.description: The security type name.

GatewayIpSecVpnTunnelSecurityTypeAllowed.description: An IPSec VPN Tunnel security type allowed for configuration of the gateway.

mode.description: Currently configured graceful restart mode. Default is HELPER_ONLY.

EdgeBgpGracefulRestartConfig.description: Describes current graceful restart configuration mode and timer for BGP configuration on an Edge Gateway.

GracefulRestartModeTypes.description:
Describes Graceful Restart configuration Modes for BGP configuration on an Edge Gateway. HELPER_ONLY mode is the ability for a BGP speaker to indicate its ability to preserve forwarding state during BGP restart. GRACEFUL_RESTART mode is the ability of a BGP speaker to advertise its restart to its peers.
  • DISABLE - Both graceful restart and helper modes are disabled.
  • HELPER_ONLY - Only helper mode is enabled.
  • GRACEFUL_AND_HELPER - Both graceful restart and helper modes are enabled.

EdgeBgpBfdConfig.description: Describes BFD configuration for failure detection.

id.description: The unique id of this BGP neighbor. On updates, the id is required for the object, while for create a new id will be generated. This id is not a VCD URN.

neighborAddress.description: The IP address of the BGP neighbor. Both IPv4 and IPv6 formats are supported.

remoteASNumber.description: The remote AS number of a BGP neighbor in ASPLAIN or ASDOT format.

keepAliveTimer.description: Specifies the time interval (in seconds) between keep alive messages sent to peer.

holdDownTimer.description: Specifies the time interval (in seconds) before declaring a peer dead. Must be at least three times the keep alive timer.

allowASIn.description:
A flag indicating whether AllowAS-in is enabled or not. This specifies whether BGP neighbors
can receive routes with same AS.

neighborPassword.description:
Password for BGP neighbor authentication. Empty string ("") clears existing password.
Not specifying a value will be treated as "no password".

inRoutesFilterRef.description:
Specifies route filtering configuration for the BGP neighbor in IN direction. It is the reference to the prefix list or route map. The type of the filter can be specified by using type field. Allowed values for type are:
  • PREFIX_LIST
  • ROUTE_MAP
Default type is prefix list. Not specifying a value for this filter will be treated as "no IN route filters".

outRoutesFilterRef.description:
Specifies route filtering configuration for the BGP neighbor in OUT direction. It is the reference to the prefix list or route map. The type of the filter can be specified by using type field. Allowed values for type are:
  • PREFIX_LIST
  • ROUTE_MAP
Default type is prefix list. Not specifying a value for this filter will be treated as "no OUT route filters".

network.description:
The network prefix in CIDR format. If the value is not specified,
it will be treated as "ANY" which means match all networks.
Both IPv4 and IPv6 formats are supported.

greaterThanEqualTo.description: The value which the prefix length must be greater than or equal to. Must be less than or equal to 'lessThanEqualTo'

lessThanEqualTo.description: The value which the prefix length must be less than or equal to. Must be greater than or equal to 'greaterThanEqualTo'

CommonGatewayPrefixListEntry.description: A network prefix entry used for routing purposes.

applicationProfileType.description:
The profile type of application that this Virtual Service is configured with. A value of "-" represents an unknown type.
  • HTTP - Virtual Service supports HTTP protocol.
  • HTTPS - Virtual Service supports HTTPS protocol.
  • L4 - Virtual Service supports Layer 4 (Transport) using UDP/TCP protocol.
  • L4_TLS - Virtual Service supports Layer 4 (Transport) using UDP/TCP protocol with TLS.

applicationProfile.description: Specifies the application profile for the virtual service such as whether it's HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP/UDP.

EdgeLoadBalancerVirtualServiceSummary.description: A Virtual Service for an Edge Gateway.

name.description: Name for the Load Balancer Pool. Name is unique across all pools for an Edge Gateway.

activeMonitoringEnabled.description: Whether active monitoring for this pool is enabled or not.

virtualServiceRefs.description:
The list of Load Balancer Virtual Services associated with this Load balancer Pool.
Only first 10 Virtual Services will be returned.

memberSslEnabled.description: Whether SSL is enabled for communication between the Load Balancer Virtual Services and the pool members

memberGroupType.description:
The type of Edge Firewall Group representing destination servers which are used by the Load Balancer Pool to direct load balanced traffic. This value will be absent if the pool is using an IP Address-based pool member specification instead of an Edge Firewall Group. Valid values include:
  • IP_SET
  • STATIC_MEMBERS
  • VM_CRITERIA

EdgeLoadBalancerPoolSummary.description: Specifies a summary of a Load Balancer pool.

cross-reference.description: The URN of the health monitor with which the pools are associated.  Only one should be specified.

id.description: The identifier of a Load Balancer Health Monitor in URN format

name.description: Name of the Health Monitor. Name of the system defined monitors are prefixed with System for example 'System-HTTP'.

description.description: Description of the Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

type.description:
Type of the health monitors. A value of "-" represents an unknown type. Supported values are:
  • HTTP - HTTP request/response is used to validate health.
  • HTTPS - Used against HTTPS encrypted web servers to validate health.
  • TCP - TCP connection is used to validate health.
  • UDP - A UDP datagram is used to validate health.
  • PING - An ICMP ping is used to validate health.

poolCount.description: Number of pools associated with this Load Balancer Health Monitor.

scope.description:
The definition scope of an Edge Gateway Load Balancer Health Monitor.
  • SYSTEM - Health Monitors are default profiles provided by the backing Load Balancer.
  • PROVIDER - Health Monitors are defined by the provider at a system level and associated to a Load Balancer Pool by the provider on behalf of the tenant.
  • TENANT - Health Monitors are available only for a tenant's specific Load Balancer. They are defined by the tenant or by a provider on behalf of a tenant.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorSummary.description: Specifies a summary of a Load Balancer Pool Health Monitor.

cross-reference.description: The URN of the pool with which the health monitors are associated.  Only one should be specified.

name.description: Name of the application profile. Name of the system defined monitors are prefixed with System for example 'System-HTTP'.

type.description:
The profile type of application that this Virtual Service is configured with. A value of "-" represents an unknown type. Such profile can still be removed from the Virtual Service on update but is not valid on create. Values are below.
  • HTTP - Virtual Service supports HTTP protocol.
  • HTTPS - Virtual Service supports HTTPS protocol.
  • L4 - Virtual Service supports Layer 4 (Transport) using UDP/TCP protocol.
  • L4_TLS - Virtual Service supports Layer 4 (Transport) using UDP/TCP protocol with TLS.
L4_TLS is allowed only on Edge Gateway Load Balancer with PREMIUM feature set.

systemDefined.description: Whether the Application Profile is system defined.

EdgeLoadBalancerApplicationProfile.description: Specifies the application profile for the virtual service such as whether it's HTTP, HTTPS, or TCP/UDP.

id.description: The identifier of the Virtual Service in URN format

name.description: The name of the Virtual Service. Name is unique across all Virtual Services for an Edge Gateway.

description.description: The description of the Virtual Service.

enabled.description: A flag indicating whether Virtual Service is enabled or not.

virtualIpAddress.description:
The IPv4 virtual IP Address (VIP) of the Virtual Service if required. This IP can be an allocated IP to the Gateway from the External Network or
it can be an internal IP address used for internal load balancing.

ipv6VirtualIpAddress.description:
The IPv6 virtual IP Address (VIP) of the Virtual Service if required. This IP can be an allocated IP to the Gateway from the External Network or
it can be an internal IP address used for internal load balancing.

loadBalancerPoolRef.description: The Load Balancer Pool associated with this Virtual Service.

gatewayRef.description: The Edge Gateway associated with this Virtual Service.

serviceEngineGroupRef.description: The Load Balancer Service Engine Group that is assigned to the Edge Gateway. This Virtual Service will be deployed to this Service Engine Group.

certificateRef.description: The certificate used for SSL termination for the Virtual Service. This is required if the service port type is "HTTPS" or "L4_TLS".

servicePorts.description: A list of service ports supported by this Virtual Service.  Multiple L4 service ports may require an Edge Gateway Load Balancer with PREMIUM feature set.

healthStatus.description:
The current health status of the virtual service. Possible values are:
  • UP - The virtual service is healthy.
  • DOWN - The virtual service is down, inactive, or has failed.
  • DISABLED - The virtual service is disabled.
  • UNAVAILABLE - The virtual service is unavailable.
  • PENDING - The virtual service is being creating or resources are being allocated.
  • UNKNOWN - The virtual service state is unknown.

healthMessage.description: The localized message on the health of the virtual service.

detailedHealthMessage.description: The non-localized detailed message on the health of the virtual service.

transparentModeEnabled.description:
A flag indicating whether or not Preserve Client IP is enabled for this virtual service. In order to enable Preserve Client IP
on the virtual service, Transparent Mode must be enabled on the Edge Gateway.

nonCriticalLoggingEnabled.description:
A flag indicating whether non-critical logging is active for the virtual service or not. Once activated, logs are captured for
30 minutes. At the end of this time, non-critical logging is deactivated and this flag will become false.

EdgeLoadBalancerVirtualServiceCommonProp.description: Specifies common properties for Virtual Service objects.

methodMatch.description: HTTP methods such as GET, PUT, DELETE, POST etc.

queryMatch.description: HTTP request query strings in key=value format.

CommonEdgeVirtualServiceHttpMatchCriteri.description: Defines common properties of a HTTP match criteria.

type.description: Type of log. Either CRITICAL or NON_CRITICAL.

uriPath.description: The URI path of the request from the client.

responseCode.description: The HTTP response status code returned by the load balancer.

responseLength.description: The size, in bytes, of the HTTP header plus content returned from the application to the load balancer.

requestLength.description: The size of the HTTP request in bytes.

requestId.description: The unique identifier of the request.

totalTime.description: Total time in milliseconds from when a client sent a request until it receives the response.

wafStatus.description:
The result of WAF evaluation if a WAF evaluation has occurred. Possible values are:
  • REJECTED - WAF is in ENFORCEMENT mode and the request was rejected.
  • FLAGGED - WAF is in DETECTION mode and the request was logged, but not rejected.
  • PASSED - Request passed the WAF without any match.
  • BYPASSED - When the request matches with the Allowlist and the Allowlist handles the request.
  • NOT_APPLICABLE - The request was not evaluated by WAF.
  • UNKNOWN - If the status cannot be determined, the value will be UNKNOWN.

criticalitySummary.description: If the connection or request is determined to be critical, then this field provides a human-readable summary of all critical issues.

cross-reference.description: Total duration of logs in seconds.
ISO 8601 timestamp of the log request start time in UTC.
ISO 8601 timestamp of the log request end time in UTC.

criticalityCodes.description: List of codes which indicate why a log is critical.

criticalitySummary.description: If the connection or request is determined to be critical, then this field provides a human-readable summary of all critical issues.

protocol.description:
The protocol used for communicating between client and server. Possible values are:
  • TCP
  • UDP
  • ICMP
  • SCTP

type.description: Type of log. Either CRITICAL or NON_CRITICAL.

totalTime.description: Total time in milliseconds from when a client sent a request until it receives the response.

clientPort.description: Load balancer port on which client connection has been made.

clientLocation.description: The client's country of origin for the IP address or Internal for private IP addresses.

clientRtt.description: The TCP round trip time between the load balancer and client.

startTimestamp.description: Start timeStamp in ISO 8601 format when a client sends a request.

totalBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the content received and transmitted between the load balancer and client.

rxBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the received packets at the client.

txBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the transmitted packets at the client.

totalPackets.description: Number of total packets received and transmitted between the load balancer and client.

rxPackets.description: Number of received packets at the client.

txPackets.description: Number of transmitted packets at the client.

outOfOrders.description: Number of out of order packets at the client.

timeouts.description: Number of timed out packets at the client.

retransmits.description: Number of retransmitted packets at the client.

windowShrinkCount.description: Number of times the client has reduced its TCP receive window.

zeroWindowSizeEvents.description:
Indicates total zero window updates sent and received at client.
In TCP, a zero window advertisement is sent from a receiver when its buffer is filled and cannot receive more data.

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions. One request, one/multiple responses is considered as one transaction.

averageTurntime.description: This is a smoothed moving average of number of transactions.

maxSegmentSize.description: This indicates the maximum segment size negotiated for the connection. This is only applicable for a TCP Connection.

synRetransmitCount.description: Number of times the SYN packet is retransmitted by the load balancer due to not getting a SYN+ACK from the peer node.

applicationPort.description: Application port on which load balancer connection has been made.

applicationRtt.description: The TCP round trip time between the load balancer and the application.

applicationTotalBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the content received and transmitted between the load balancer and the application.

applicationRxBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the received packets at the application.

applicationTxBytes.description: The size, in bytes, of the transmitted packets at the application.

applicationTotalPackets.description: Number of total packets received and transmitted between the load balancer and the application.

applicationRxPackets.description: Number of received packets at the application.

applicationTxPackets.description: Number of transmitted packets at the application.

applicationOutOfOrders.description: Number of out of order packets at the application.

applicationTimeouts.description: Number of timed out packets at the application.

applicationRetransmits.description: Number of retransmitted packets at the application.

applicationZeroWindowSizeEvents.description:
Indicates total zero window updates sent and received at application.
In TCP, a zero window advertisement is sent from a receiver when its buffer is filled and cannot receive more data.

persistenceUsed.description: A boolean value indicating whether persistence applied during server selection.

applicationWindowShrinkCount.description: Number of times the application has reduced its TCP receive window.

sslVersion.description: For an L4 SSL Application, this indicates the SSL version.

sslCipher.description: For an L4 SSL Application, this indicates cipher used to secure network between client and server.

EdgeVirtualServiceL4LogSummary.description: A Virtual Service L4 log summary.

cross-reference.description: Total duration of logs in seconds.
ISO 8601 timestamp of the log request start time in UTC.
ISO 8601 timestamp of the log request end time in UTC.

name.description: Name of the Persistence profile.

type.description:
Type of persistence strategy to use. Supported values are:
  • CLIENT_IP - The client’s IP is used as the identifier and mapped to the server.
  • HTTP_COOKIE - Load Balancer inserts a cookie into HTTP responses. Cookie name must be provided as value.
  • CUSTOM_HTTP_HEADER - Custom, static mappings of header values to specific servers are used. Header name must be provided as value.
  • APP_COOKIE - Load Balancer reads existing server cookies or URI embedded data such as JSessionID. Cookie name must be provided as value.
  • TLS - Information is embedded in the client’s SSL/TLS ticket ID. This will use default system profile "System-Persistence-TLS".
Using CUSTOM_HTTP_HEADER, APP_COOKIE, TLS persistence types requires an Edge Gateway Load Balancer with PREMIUM feature set.

value.description:
Value of attribute based on selected persistence type.
This is required for HTTP_COOKIE, CUSTOM_HTTP_HEADER and APP_COOKIE persistence types.
HTTP_COOKIE, APP_COOKIE must have cookie name set as the value and CUSTOM_HTTP_HEADER must have header name set as the value.

EdgeLoadBalancerPersistenceProfile.description:
Specifies the Persistence profile for a Load Balancer Pool.
Persistence profile will ensure that the same user sticks to the same server for a desired duration of time.
If the persistence profile is unmanaged by Cloud Director, updates that leave the values unchanged will continue to use the same unmanaged profile.
Any changes made to the persistence profile will cause Cloud Director to switch the pool to a profile managed by Cloud Director.

ipAddress.description: The ip address of the Load Balancer Pool member.

port.description: The port number of the Load Balancer Pool member. If unset, the port that the client used to connect will be used.

ratio.description: The ratio of selecting eligible servers in the pool.

enabled.description: Whether the Load Balancer Pool member is enabled or not.

healthStatus.description:
The current health status of the pool member. Possible values are:
  • UP - The member is operational.
  • DOWN - The member is down.
  • DISABLED - The member is disabled
  • UNKNOWN - The state is unknown.

markedDownBy.description:
When the member is DOWN, the value gives the names of the health monitors that marked the member as down.
If a monitor cannot be determined, the value will be UNKNOWN.

detailedHealthMessage.description: The non-localized detailed message on the health of the pool member.

EdgeLoadBalancerPoolMember.description: Defines a member (a destination server) in a Load Balancer Pool.

id.description: The unique ID of this Load Balancer Pool. On updates, the ID is required for the pool, while for create a new ID will be generated.

description.description: The description of the Load Balancer Pool.

enabled.description: True if Load Balancer Pool is enabled.

passiveMonitoringEnabled.description: Whether passive monitoring for this pool is enabled or not.

healthStatus.description:
The current health status of the pool. Possible values are:
  • UP - The pool is operational.
  • RUNNING - The pool is operational, but less than 50% of the pool members are up.
  • DOWN - All members in the pool are down.
  • DISABLED - Either the pool is disabled or all of the members are disabled.
  • UNAVAILABLE - The pool is unavailable. Examples: pool has no members or pool is not assigned to any virtual service.
  • UNKNOWN - The pool state is unknown.

memberCount.description: The total number of members in the pool.

enabledMemberCount.description: The number of enabled members in the pool.

upMemberCount.description: The number of enabled members in the pool that are operational.

healthMessage.description: The localized message on the health of the pool.

port.description: The port to use for the health check.  If not specified, the Load Balancer Pool port will be used by default.

requestData.description: The data to send to the application as part of the health check.

expectedResponseData.description: Keyword to match in the first 2KB of the response headers or the response body. If no match made, the Load Balancer Pool member will be marked as unhealthy.

EdgeLoadBalancerHealthMonitorL4CommonSet.description: Specifies settings that are applicable to both TCP and UDP Load Balancer Pool Health Monitors.
